programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy

Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB has sent dates back to 1935. year when it was launched called "Tschammer-Pokal". The 64 teams involves all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga in this competition with the first four teams on the third league table. The rest of the participant comes by the winners of regional cups. The matches are played at a single cup system in which the extensions are played after regular 90 minutes, and after that the elevator unless the winner decides until then. The finals played every year since 1985. in the Olympic stadium in Berlin. The customer of the Cup provides a placement in UEFA Europe League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: Russian Premier League / Fudbal: Ruska Premier Liga

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Antoaneta Frankeva / Зала на славата: Антоанета Френкева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Woody Allen's Panorama: Hollywood Finals / Панорама на Уди Алън: Финал по холивудски
programme.desc: Once winning the Academy Awards, now director Val Waxman is in the shade, shooting commercially on television, unpleasantly strives to control everything and is increasingly suffering from hypochondria. His ex -wife, Eli, believes he will still make the movie that "The City will not fall asleep." She manages to convince the big "sharks", led by her current husband Hal that Val is the "most appropriate director" for their new $ 60 million project. All that remains is Agent Al to convince Val himself that this will be his "big return" on the screen against a $ 500,000 fee and a percentage of profits. With the "green light" from the producers, the preparation begins. Despite the artist's ideas to rebuild all of New York and the choice of an Asian operator with a constant translator, the work goes smoothly until ... the night before the photos, when the unexplained ... The director is blinded, but he has to shoot and try to hide the problem if he ever wants to work in this Hollywood ... / Някога печелил награди "Оскар", сега режисьорът Вал Уаксман е в сянка, снима комерсиално в телевизия, неприятно се стреми да контролира всичко и все по-силно страда от хипохондрия. Бившата му съпруга Ели вярва, че той все пак ще заснеме филма, с който "градът няма да заспи". Тя успява да убеди големите "акули", начело с настоящия й съпруг Хал, че Вал е "най-подходящият режисьор" за техния нов проект от 60 млн. долара. Остава само агентът Ал да убеди самия Вал, че това ще бъде "голямото му завръщане" на екрана срещу хонорар от 500 хиляди долара и процент от печалбата. Със "зелена светлина" от продуцентите подготовката започва. Въпреки идеите на художника да престрои цял Ню Йорк и избора на азиатски оператор с постоянен преводач, работата върви гладко до... нощта преди снимките, когато се случва необяснимото... Режисьорът ослепява, но трябва да снима и се опитва да скрие проблема, ако иска някога пак да работи в този Холивуд...

programme.title: Football: UEFA European Championship for Women 2025: semifinals: England - Italy / Футбол: УЕФА Европейско първенство за жени 2025: Полуфинал: Англия - Италия
programme.desc: The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. The team of England will defend its title, won 3 years ago on home land. The biggest competitors are the world champions from Spain, who are the team with the most front ranking in Europe in the FIFA rankings- second place. The German squad, which lost the final 3 years ago, is a record holder for European victories, triumphed 8 times in the previous 13 editions, but their last title has been in 2013 in the top ten of the world rankings are the teams of Sweden and France. / 16-те най-добри дамски отбора на континента се събират в Швейцария, за да се борят за купата в 14-ия европейски шампионат. Отборът на Англия ще защитава титлата си, спечелена преди 3 години на родна земя. Най-големите конкурентки са световните шампионки от Испания, които са и отборът с най- предно класиране от Европа в ранглистата на ФИФА – второ място. Съставът на Германия, който загуби финала преди 3 години след продължения, е рекордьор по европейски победи, като е триумфирал 8 пъти в досегашните 13 издания, но последната им титла е от 2013 г. В първата десетка на световната ранглиста са още отборите на Швеция и Франция.

programme.desc: The 16 best ladies' teams on the continent gather in Switzerland to fight for the Cup in the 14th European Championship. Kraljevi ljeta
programme.desc: Three teenage friends, Joe, Patrick and Eskcentric and unpredictable Baiggio, in the last act of the search for independence, decide to launch the summer by building a house in the forest and living from nature. Free from the rules set by their parents, their idyllic summer soon becomes a test of their friendship, as every boy learns to appreciate the fact that the family is, whether he is the one you were born in or the one you created, something you cannot escape from. / Tri prijatelja tinejdžera, Joe, Patrick i eskcentrični i nepredvidljivi Baiggio, u posljednjem činu potrage za neovisnošći, odluče preovesti ljeto gradeći kuću u šumi i živjeti od prirode. Slobodni od pravila koje im postavljaju roditelji, njihovo idilično ljeto ubrzo postane test njihova prijateljstva, kako svaki dječak uči cijeniti činjenicu da je obitelj, bez obzira je li ona u kojoj si rođen ili ona koju si sam stvorio, nešto od čega ne možeš pobjeći.

programme.title: Zameteni
programme.desc: After an extremely unwanted one -night socializing, the two strangers wake up and find in a snowstorm after sleeping a storm that killed Manhattan with ice. Now they are trapped together, in a small apartment, forced to get to know each other better. / Nakon iznimno neželjenog druženja za jednu noć, dvoje stranaca se probude i nađu u snježnoj oluji, nakon što su prespavali oluju koja je okovala Manhattan ledom. Sada su zarobljeni zajedno, u malom stanu, prisiljeni bolje se upoznati.

programme.desc: Football: Conmebol Libertadores - (Sport. Program, 2025) Copa Libertadores is founded annually in 1960 and performs 38 best teams of South America. Throughout history, the format of the competition has changed, from the fact that only the champions of their leagues have the right to play, to the present day, when each Member State gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's great Independiente. Argentina gave the most Cope conqueror. The competition has an iconic status and is considered to be one of the more tender football events on the planet ... / Football: CONMEBOL Libertadores - (sport. program, 2025) Copa Libertadores godišnje je natjecanje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih momčadi Južne Amerike. Kroz povijest format natjecanja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci svojih liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država članica daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspješniji klub s najviše osvojenih naslova argentinski je velikan Independiente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Cope. Natjecanje ima ikonički status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivijih nogometnih događaja na planetu...

programme.title: Arsenal - Dinamo Zagreb, Football, Champions League / Arsenal - Dinamo Zagreb, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a Championship Cup was founded, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program, 2025) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Bielefeld - Leverkusen, Football, German Cup / Bielefeld - Leverkusen, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

Za naredni trofej momčadi sa Apeninskog poluotoka su trebali pričekati do 1936. godine kada se natjecanje opet počelo održavati i održava se svake godine. Pomalo kuriozitetan podatak je slabija posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na Serie A zbog tradicije odmaranja ponajboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih momčadi. No, sve to pada u vodu prilikom završnice turnira kada se pobjedniku osigurava sigurno mjesto u skupinama UEFA Europa lige. Tada interes za ovo natjecanje rapidno raste. Pravi ljubitelj talijanskog nogometa će sigurno popratiti ovo natjecanje!...

programme.title: George Best: Potpuno sam
programme.desc: George Best: All by Himself - (dok. film, Engleska, 2016) Dokumentarni film o Georgeu Bestu, nogometašu iz Belfasta koji je zadivio svijet svojim umijećem na nogometnim travnjacima. Osim po tome, ostao je upamćen i po svom burnom životu izvan terena. Prekomjerno uživanju u alkoholu i raskalašeni način života odrazili su se na njegovoj nogometnoj karijeri. Iako nije slavno završio karijeru, Best je ostao upisan u povijest nogometa kao jedan od najtalentiranijih igrača na svijetu. R.: Daniel Gordon Ul.: George Best (Himself), Angie Best (Herself), Calum Best (Himself), Matt Busby (Himself), Manchester United F.C. (Themselves)...

programme.title: Bielefeld - Leverkusen, Football, German Cup / Bielefeld - Leverkusen, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Barcelona - Inter, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Chelsea - Copenhagen, Nogomet, Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: UEFA Conference League - (sport. program, 2025) Od 2021. godine ljubitelji nogometa uživaju u Ligi Konferencija koju organizira UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane momčadi državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u natjecanje ulaze 32 ekipe koje su podijeljene u osam skupina po četiri. 16 momčadi napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale...

programme.title: PSG - Tottenham, Football: UEFA Super Cup / Psg - Tottenham, Nogomet: UEFA Superkup
programme.desc: The UEFA Super Cup - (Sport. Program, 2025) UEFA European Super Cup is a trophy, for which the winners of two club continental competitions, the Champions League and the Europa League are fighting. The European Super Cup traditionally begins the season of European club competitions. The first supercomba was played in 1973 and the winner was Ajax. The teams with the most won titles are Spanish Barcelona and Italian Milan. By far the most title is held by the Spanish team ... / UEFA Super Cup - (sport. program, 2025) UEFA europski superkup trofej je za koji se bore pobjednici dvaju klupskih kontinentalnih natjecanja, Lige prvaka i Europske lige. Europskim superkupom tradicionalno započinje sezona europskih klupskih natjecanja. Prvi Superkup igran je 1973. godine, a osvajač je bio Ajax. Momčadi s najviše osvojenih naslova su španjolska Barcelona i talijanski Milan. Daleko najviše naslova drže španjolske momčadi...

programme.title: Magazin Lige prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Magazine - (sport. program) Magazin Lige prvaka donosi cjelokupni pregled vijesti, vezanih uz zbivanja na nogometnom travnjaku, za sve ljubitelje nogometa. Predstavlja i neke od najvećih nogometnih zvijezda, kao i zanimljive razgovore u kojima otkrivaju sve detalje nogometnog života. ...

programme.title: Greatest Club
programme.desc: Greatest Club - (dok. film) Nogometna povijest je prožeta velikim utakmicama koje su pojedine momčadi učinile velikima i upisale zlatnim slovima u nogometnu povijest. U svakoj polusatnoj epizodi predstavljena je jedna momčad koja je svojim uspjesima zaslužila da se podsjetite njenih veličanstvenih uspjeha i padova. Budite uz vaše tv ekrane i prisjetite se najzanimljivijih trenutaka i događaja u svjetskom nogometu iz kuta najznačajnijih nogometnih timova...

programme.title: Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europa League Highlights - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Ova sezona bit će posebna jer se po prvi puta natječe samo 10 ekipa što pojačava borbu i na vrhu i na dnu tabele. Ulog je ogroman, na kraju će samo jedna ekipa izboriti Europu...

programme.title: Finale, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Finals, Football, Europa League / Finale, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Shelbourne - Rijeka, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / Shelbourne - Rijeka, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -ranked entering 2nd qualifying round for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Karlovac 1919 - Jarun, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 1st round / Karlovac 1919 - Jarun, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 1. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Vukovar 1991 - Istria 1961, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 3rd round / Vukovar 1991 - Istra 1961, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 3. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -ranked entering 2nd qualifying round for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

Med over 130 millioner solgte album og legendariske koncerter er The Boss en beskeden troubadour, der forener litteratur, film og rocknroll - og viser os USAs sande ansigt.

programme.desc: Politiske insidere og ledere afslører, hvordan Amerikas mest magtfulde har håndteret chokerende rapporter om folkedrab og krigsforbrydelser.

programme.title: Can’t Feel Nothing
programme.desc: The Internet has changed the world - it is clearly seen in the street scene, in public transport, in the school yard, etc., where most people have their eyes on their phones. But how has the Internet affected our inner life - our feelings and minds? This documentary focuses sharply on how people and businesses associated with the Internet - especially its darker corners - try to control our feelings to make money and what consequences it has. / Internettet har forandret verden - det ses tydeligt i gadebilledet, i den offentlige transport, i skolegården osv., hvor de fleste har blikket rettet mod deres telefoner. Men hvordan har internettet påvirket vores indre liv - vores følelser og sind?Denne dokumentar stiller skarpt på, hvordan personer og virksomheder med tilknytning til internettet - især dets mørkere afkroge - forsøger at kontrollere vores følelser for at tjene penge, og hvilke konsekvenser det har.

programme.desc: 2nd World War was a struggle for firepower. The fate of the nations was decided by how strong weapons they had. A queen who did everything to save his country. / Hun har fascineret os i over 2000 år. Kleopatra blev født i år 69 før vor tid i Alexandria, og lige fra hun var barn, måtte hun kæmpe for sit liv og for Egyptens trone. Arkæologer leder utrætteligt efter hendes forsvundne grav, der er omgærdet af lige så mange myter som dronningen selv. Kom med på jagt efter den sidste farao i Egypten. programme.desc: March 1945. The US forces are moving into Germany, and the Nazi high command gives the German army order to blow up an important bridge in the air to slow them down. However, Major Kreuger hesitates to obey the order, for it will cut off his troops from their homeland. At the same time, Americans are ordered to capture the Germans. / Marts 1945. De amerikanske styrker er ved at rykke ind i Tyskland, og den nazistiske højkommando giver den tyske hær ordre på at sprænge en vigtig bro i luften for at sinke dem. Major Kreuger tøver dog med at adlyde ordren, for den vil afskære hans tropper fra deres hjemland. Samtidig får amerikanerne ordre på at tage tyskerne til fange.

programme.title: Bullshit
programme.desc: Bullshit talks about how pursuing a dream of social rebellion can mean boarding a train on its way to a collision. Pia and Henning's intense love story reach a sudden ending. / BULLSHIT fortæller om, hvordan det at forfølge en drøm om socialt oprør kan betyde, at man stiger ombord på et tog, der er på vej mod en kollision. Pia og Hennings intense kærlighedshistorie når en brat afslutning.

programme.title: Bullshit
programme.desc: Bullshit talks about how pursuing a dream of social rebellion can mean boarding a train on its way to a collision. programme.title: Den klassiske musikquiz
programme.desc: How hard is it to recognize music played from behind? Can you play orchestra music on percussion instruments? And is it at all possible to decide a piece of music after just a single tone? Frederik Cilius and Mathias Hammer are the team captains who control the evening's two teams through the challenges. The DR Symphony Orchestra and conductor Thomas Søndergård stand for the music, while Phillip Faber is the obvious host trying to keep track of the lies. / Hvor svært er det at genkende musik spillet bagfra? Kan man spille orkestermusik på slagtøjsinstrumenter? Og er det overhovedet muligt at bestemme et stykke musik efter bare en enkelt tone? Frederik Cilius og Mathias Hammer er holdkaptajnerne, der styrer aftenens to hold gennem udfordringerne. DR SymfoniOrkestret og dirigent Thomas Søndergård står for musikken, mens Phillip Faber er den oplagte vært, der forsøger at holde styr på løjerne.

programme.title: Picasso - the beauty and the beast / Picasso - Skønheden og udyret
programme.desc: He was one of the most important artists of the 20th century. Spanish painter Pablo Picasso was born in 1881. He revolutionized art history, experienced two world wars and portrayed a century filled with chaos, hope and despair. His art was often brutal, but also managed to capture beauty in suffering. In private, he was full of contradictions and left chaotic conditions - and art enough to fill a plane hangar. Here's his story. / Han var en af de vigtigste kunstnere i det 20. århundrede. Den spanske maler Pablo Picasso blev født i 1881. Han revolutionerede kunsthistorien, gennemlevede to verdenskrige og skildrede et århundrede fyldt med kaos, håb og fortvivlelse. Hans kunst var ofte brutal, men formåede også at indfange skønhed i lidelsen. Privat var han fuld af modsætninger og efterlod sig kaotiske forhold - og kunst nok til at fylde en flyhangar. Her er hans historie.

programme.title: TVA
programme.desc: Every day TV Newspaper gives an overview of the most important news from Denmark and the world around us and picks up, provides an overview and perspective on the greatest events and stories of the time. / TV Avisen giver hver dag et overblik over dagens vigtigste nyheder fra Danmark og verden omkring os og samler op, giver overblik og perspektiv på de største begivenheder og historier i tiden.

programme.title: Port Cities of the Future - Guard against the Storm River / Fremtidens havnebyer - værn mod stormfloden
programme.desc: How can we stay in our cities as the sea rises? Are waterproof houses better than tall walls shielding for the view? Or should we withdraw all the way back and up in the country? Clouds have long been a problem, but storm surge will get far worse. Denmark's 10 largest cities are port cities, and they have to choose how they will protect themselves from the rising seawater of the future. / Hvordan kan vi blive boende i vores byer, når havet stiger? Er vandtætte huse bedre end høje mure, der skærmer for udsigten? Eller skal vi trække os helt tilbage og op i landet? Skybrud har længe været et problem, men stormflod vil blive langt værre. Danmarks 10 største byer er havnebyer, og de skal vælge, hvordan de vil beskytte sig mod fremtidens stigende havvand.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam and Tusker have formed pairs for 20 years. They are more in love than ever and go on a trip in their motorhome through England. Two years ago, Tusker was diagnosed with early dementia and they know their time together is limited. As the journey progresses, it turns out that their wishes for the future are different, and they are both confronted with the question of what it really means to love each other. / Sam og Tusker har dannet par i 20 år. De er mere forelskede end nogensinde og drager på tur i deres autocamper gennem England. For to år siden blev Tusker diagnosticeret med tidlig demens, og de ved, at deres tid sammen er begrænset. Som rejsen skrider frem, viser det sig, at deres ønsker for fremtiden er forskellige, og de konfronteres begge med spørgsmålet om, hvad det egentlig betyder at elske hinanden.

programme.title: Under the Banner of Heaven
programme.desc: Criminal officer Pyre is investigating the murder of Brenda Wright Lafferty and her little daughter in a suburb of Salt Lake Valley and reveals buried truths that make him question his own faith. / Kriminalbetjent Pyre efterforsker mordet på Brenda Wright Lafferty og hendes lille datter i en forstad i Salt Lake Valley og afslører begravede sandheder, der får ham til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved sin egen tro.

programme.title: Nordirlands blodige borgerkrig
programme.desc: It is 26 years since a peace agreement was concluded in Northern Ireland, but the conflict still leaves deep traces. With the help of personal testimony and a rich archive, the conflict comes closer than ever. / Det er 26 år siden, der blev indgået en fredsaftale i Nordirland, men konflikten sætter stadig dybe spor. Ved hjælp af personlige vidnesbyrd og et rigt arkiv kommer konflikten tættere på end nogensinde.

programme.title: Optimistens guide til planeten
programme.desc: Actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau seeks activists and researchers who develop innovative solutions to some of our biggest environmental challenges. / Skuespiller Nikolaj Coster-Waldau opsøger aktivister og forskere, der udvikler innovative løsninger på nogle af vores største miljøudfordringer.

programme.title: Oldtidens ingeniørarbejde
programme.desc: The Pyramids, Stonehenge, the Great Wall of China, Notre Dame and Taj Mahal, we study these pieces of art that ancient engineering has produced and look at how they have characterized modern buildings. / Pyramiderne, Stonehenge, den kinesiske mur, Notre Dame og Taj Mahal, vi studerer disse kunststykker som oldtidens ingeniørarbejde har frembragt og ser på, hvordan de har præget moderne bygninger.

programme.title: Oldtidens ingeniørarbejde
programme.desc: The Pyramids, Stonehenge, the Great Wall of China, Notre Dame and Taj Mahal, we study these pieces of art that ancient engineering has produced and look at how they have characterized modern buildings. / Pyramiderne, Stonehenge, den kinesiske mur, Notre Dame og Taj Mahal, vi studerer disse kunststykker som oldtidens ingeniørarbejde har frembragt og ser på, hvordan de har præget moderne bygninger.

programme.title: Kriminalfotograferne
programme.desc: Two Danish crime photographers' fierce rivalry to take the best, most dramatic photos to each of their tabloid newspaper in the 1980s and 90s, form the framework for the documentary series The Crime Photographers. / To danske kriminalfotografers indædte rivalisering om at tage de bedste, mest dramatiske fotos til hver sin tabloidavis i 1980erne og 90erne, danner rammen for dokumentarserien Kriminalfotograferne.

programme.title: On the shoulders of Bohr / På skuldrene af Bohr
programme.desc: Danish science series from 2022 on the inexplicities of quantum physics, which is based on the ideas and thoughts the Danish physicist Niels Bohr had 100 years ago and which became the foundation of the quantum mechanics. A theory of the smallest things in the universe. / Dansk videnskabsserie fra 2022 om kvantefysikkens uforklarligheder, som tager udgangspunkt i de ideer og tanker den danske fysiker Niels Bohr havde for 100 år siden, og som blev fundamentet til kvantemekanikken. En teori om de allermindste ting i universet.

programme.title: Alt forladt
programme.desc: The two Urban Explorers Jan Elhøj and Morten Kirckhoff are exploring abandoned places. / De to Urban Explorers Jan Elhøj og Morten Kirckhoff udforsker forladte steder.

programme.title: Verdens smukkeste togrejser
programme.desc: Join us out on some of the most scenic train journeys in the world. From Norway to New Zealand we meet the people who work and live along the railways. / Kom med ud på nogle af de mest naturskønne togrejser i verden. Fra Norge til New Zealand møder vi de mennesker, der arbejder og bor langs jernbanerne.

programme.title: Det fantastiske byliv
programme.desc: Urban life is crucial to the well -being of citizens. Danish-Canadian urban planner Mikael Colville-Andersen explores how to create a modern and human-friendly urban design. / Byliv har afgørende betydning for borgernes trivsel. Den dansk-canadiske byplanlægger Mikael Colville-Andersen udforsker, hvordan man skaber et moderne og menneskevenligt bydesign.

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: As one of the oldest still existing news programs on German television, the magazine has been broadcast since December 1952. The current events are reported at home and abroad. / Als eine der altesten noch bestehenden Nachrichtensendungen im deutschen Fernsehen wird das Magazin bereits seit Dezember 1952 ausgestrahlt. Berichtet wird uber das aktuelle Geschehen im In- und Ausland.

programme.title: The account - part 2 / Das Konto - Teil 2
programme.desc: From one day to the other, the life of the successful manager Michael Muhlhausen (Heino Ferch) has changed radically. First of all, the group management rejects its fundamentally prepared project of an enemy takeover of the most important competitive company without justification. Then the chief chemist Osterwald (Michael Gwisdek) is found shot - and a cleverly launched network of indications interprets Muhlhausen as a tider. The lawyer Laura Spiegelberg (Franziska Petri) wants to help him prove his innocence and is also murdered. On the escape from the police, Muhlhausen will receive unexpected help from the Polish Mafioso Pawel Sikorsky (Hermann Beyer), who hopes to get into the business in this way. When Muhlhausen contacts his wife Charlotte (Julia Jager), he has to take another jerk: Charlotte had an affarity with the murdered Osterwald. In the secret apartment, both used for their rendezvous, Charlotte finds documents that show that Osterwald should contaminate the products of the competition with a specially breeded salmonella culture. Funke AG ruined thereby a snap compared to Muhlhausen's conventional takeover tarpaulins. In the attempt, company boss Dr. Charlotte is also murdered to warn Funke (Hansjurgen hurrig). Muhlhausen now has to pull his head out of the loop and at the same time prevent a Europe -wide food scandal. / Von einem Tag auf den anderen hat sich das Leben des erfolgreichen Managers Michael Muhlhausen (Heino Ferch) radikal geandert. Zunachst lehnt die Konzernleitung sein grundlich vorbereitetes Projekt einer feindlichen Übernahme des wichtigsten Konkurrenzunternehmens ohne Begrundung ab. Dann wird der Chefchemiker Osterwald (Michael Gwisdek) erschossen aufgefunden - und ein geschickt lanciertes Netz von Indizien deutet auf Muhlhausen als Tater. Die Anwaltin Laura Spiegelberg (Franziska Petri) will ihm helfen, seine Unschuld zu beweisen, und wird ebenfalls ermordet. Auf der Flucht vor der Polizei erhalt Muhlhausen unerwartete Hilfe von dem polnischen Mafioso Pawel Sikorsky (Hermann Beyer), der auf diese Weise ins Geschaft zu kommen hofft. Als Muhlhausen Kontakt mit seiner Frau Charlotte (Julia Jager) aufnimmt, muss er einen weiteren Ruckschlag einstecken: Charlotte hatte eine Affare mit dem ermordeten Osterwald. In der geheimen Wohnung, die beide fur ihre Rendezvous nutzten, findet Charlotte Unterlagen, aus denen hervorgeht, dass Osterwald die Produkte der Konkurrenz mit einer speziell gezuchteten Salmonellenkultur verseuchen sollte. Die dadurch ruinierte Funke AG ware ein Schnappchen im Vergleich zu Muhlhausens konventionellen Übernahmeplanen. Bei dem Versuch, Firmenchef Dr. Funke (Hansjurgen Hurrig) zu warnen, wird auch Charlotte ermordet. Muhlhausen muss nun seinen Kopf aus der Schlinge ziehen und gleichzeitig einen europaweiten Lebensmittelskandal verhindern.

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Girwidz is called to the town hall by Hubert and Staller. However, the police council does not experience the reason. Just as the police arrive, the master mayor fell from the burot on the second floor right in front of her eyes. An accident, suicide or murder? Hubert is the only one to perceive a movement and run up. The burea seems to be empty, but when he steps on the window, he is put into the depth himself. As Hubert wakes up in the hospital, mutual events are pile up. Anja Licht is overlooking that her ex -husband has finally woken up again. But these sentimental activity are not interested in them, but only whether the tower has been caught. Arrived with shaky legs on the guard, Hubert tears the ground under the foot: Sonja Wirth took over the executive chair from Girwidz. Shocked, Hubert has to understand that he was in a coma for a whole five years and has changed a lot ever since. The case, in which he himself had almost come to death, was laid for the files. At the time, Staller had assumed that his colleague had assumed that his colleague was a regrettable accident, the death of the master mayor was noted as suicide. In other words: In Wolfratshausen, a murder has been running freely for the years that almost had Hubert on his conscience! And obviously Hubert is now on his own in his investigation, because Staller has now gone up the job and apparently found his private happiness. But Hubert does not let himself be discouraged and rolls up the old case, in which Girwidz also plays a crucial role. Girwidz has meanwhile gone into politics ... / Girwidz wird vom Burgermeister mit Hubert und Staller ins Rathaus gerufen. Den Grund erfahrt der Polizeirat allerdings nicht. Gerade als die Polizisten ankommen, sturzt der Burgermeister direkt vor ihren Augen aus dem Burofenster im zweiten Stock. Ein Unfall, Suizid oder Mord?Hubert nimmt als Einziger eine Bewegung wahr und lauft nach oben. Das Buro scheint leer zu sein, doch als er ans Fenster tritt, wird er selbst in die Tiefe gestoSSen.Als Hubert im Krankenhaus aufwacht, haufen sich merkwurdige Begebenheiten. Anja Licht ist uberglucklich, dass ihr Exmann endlich wieder aufgewacht ist. Doch den interessieren diese Sentimentalitaten nicht, sondern nur, ob der Tater geschnappt worden ist. Mit wackeligen Beinen auf der Wache angekommen, reiSSt es Hubert den Boden unter den FuSSen weg: Sonja Wirth hat von Girwidz den Chefsessel ubernommen. Geschockt muss Hubert begreifen, dass er ganze funf Jahre im Koma lag und sich seitdem einiges geandert hat. Der Fall, bei dem er selbst beinahe zu Tode gekommen ware, wurde langst zu den Akten gelegt. Wahrend Staller damals in seinem Protokoll bei seinem Kollegen von einem bedauerlichen Unfall ausgegangen war, wurde der Tod des Burgermeisters als Suizid vermerkt. Mit anderen Worten: In Wolfratshausen lauft seit funf Jahren ein Morder frei herum, der beinahe auch Hubert auf dem Gewissen gehabt hatte! Und offensichtlich ist Hubert bei seinen Ermittlungen nun auf sich allein gestellt, denn Staller hat inzwischen den Job an den Nagel gehangt und offenbar sein privates Gluck gefunden. Aber Hubert lasst sich nicht entmutigen und rollt den alten Fall, in dem auch Girwidz eine entscheidende Rolle spielt, wieder auf. Girwidz ist namlich inzwischen in die Politik gegangen ...

programme.title: Die Carolin Kebekus Show
programme.desc: The "Carolin Kebekus Show" celebrates the big summer vacation! And is there anything more beautiful than sitting on a campsite in summer, playing games and singing around the campfire? YES! To do all of this together with Laura Larsson, Dennis and Benni Wolter. The three visit Caro on their studio campsite and exchange ideas about their personal camping anecdotes. Spoiler: Not every person in the round is a big camping fan. Of course, a bit of competition should not be missing in the "Camping Kebekus Show". Together, Carolin and her guest grab their hiking backpaw around the bet, expose the shadows in the neighboring tent and guess summer hits around the campfire - a task that is not necessarily easier if text and melody do not match. / Die "Carolin Kebekus Show" feiert die groSSen Sommerferien! Und gibt es etwas Schoneres, als im Sommer auf einem Campingplatz zu sitzen, Spiele zu spielen und am Lagerfeuer zu singen? JA! Und zwar, all das zusammen mit Laura Larsson, Dennis und Benni Wolter zu machen. Die drei besuchen Caro auf ihrem Studio-Campingplatz und tauschen sich uber ihre personlichen Camping-Anekdoten aus. Spoiler: Nicht jede Person in der Runde ist ein groSSer Camping-Fan.Immerhin, beim Camping im Studio besteht keine Gefahr, durch plotzliche Regengusse im Matsch zu versinken. Naturlich darf in der "Camping Kebekus Show" auch ein bisschen Wettbewerb nicht fehlen. Gemeinsam packen Carolin und ihre Gaste ihre Wanderrucksacke um die Wette, entlarven die Schatten im Nachbarzelt und erraten Sommerhits am Lagerfeuer - eine Aufgabe, die nicht unbedingt leichter wird, wenn Text und Melodie gar nicht zusammenpassen.

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: Hubert and Staller are called to open a flat in which water damage is suspected. It quickly becomes clear why nobody had opened the turk to the caretaker: the young tenant was killed with a pan! programme.title: Police call 110 / Polizeiruf 110
programme.desc: The successful journalist and environmental protectionist Anne Gerling (Antje Traue) is found dead in her car after an accident. Commissioners Olga Lenski (Maria Simon) and Adam Raczek (Lucas Gregorowicz) take over the investigation. Gerling had worked as an investigative journalist and was on the trail of illegal machinations of the energy group Ergatoma. The company wants to build a nuclear power plant in the Polish borderland and fights in court against the resistance of environmental units and residents around the building permit.Lelski and Raczek find that Anne Gerling was murdered and was also pregnant. The journalist knew Lukasz Franczak (Maciej Stuhr), the state judge in the process. Had his background information on the process? In the apartment of Anne Gerling, Raczek and Anne's father Eric (Max Herbrechter) find an audio file that drove the investigation in a new direction. Olga Lenski and Adam Raczek penetrate the criminal entanglements of politics, business and judiciary - until the commissioners themselves get into the crosshair of the powerful. / Die erfolgreiche Journalistin und Umweltschutzerin Anne Gerling (Antje Traue) wird nach einem Unfall tot in ihrem Wagen aufgefunden. Die Kommissare Olga Lenski (Maria Simon) und Adam Raczek (Lucas Gregorowicz) ubernehmen die Ermittlungen. Gerling hatte als investigative Journalistin gearbeitet und war illegalen Machenschaften des Energiekonzerns Ergatome auf der Spur. Das Unternehmen will im polnischen Grenzland ein Atomkraftwerk bauen und kampft vor Gericht gegen den Widerstand von Umweltverbanden und Anwohnern um die Baugenehmigung.Lenski und Raczek finden heraus, dass Anne Gerling ermordet wurde und zudem schwanger war. Lukasz Franczak (Maciej Stuhr), der zustandige Richter im Prozess, kannte die Journalistin. Hatte er ihr Hintergrundinformationen zum Prozess gegeben? In der Wohnung von Anne Gerling finden Raczek und Annes Vater Eric (Max Herbrechter) eine Audio-Datei, die die Ermittlungen in eine neue Richtung fuhren. Immer tiefer dringen Olga Lenski und Adam Raczek in die kriminellen Verstrickungen von Politik, Wirtschaft und Justiz vor - bis die Kommissare selbst ins Fadenkreuz der Machtigen geraten.

"Cloud Seeding" is the name of this technique, in which salt particles are sprayed in the cloud to create raindrops. Dander in the region have already played similar programs in order not to fall behind the tight resource of water. The fear also resonates, the neighbor could "take away" the rain clouds. "We need governance," says Dr. Abdullah Mandous, Prasident of the International Meteorological Institute (WMO). In order to avoid conflicts, clear regulations are needed for the cloud seeding.The geo-engineering can also have a safety-political component, its story shows. In 1962 the US military started a project under the name Stormfury. It was an attempt to weaken hurricanes by inserting silver iodide into the clouds. From 1967 to 1972, the US Airforce sprouted daily lead and silver iodide powder in monsoon clouds with the aim of strengthening rain traps during the secret operation Popeye in order to interrupt the post-drawer of the Vietcong. is. Because clouds are complex and not yet well understood in detail, as a visit to the Swiss research station in Erisiwil shows. Researchers around Ulrike Lohmann consider this development with concern. They warn of possible unpleasant consequences - both for politics and FUR climate. Above all, those methods that cannot only influence the local weather, but potentially the global climate are discussed. Because the consequences are sometimes difficult to calculate, a Marine Cloud Brightening is called. The basic idea is captivating: with harmless salt water, which is finely dusted, you want to make the clouds brighter over the sea, so that they shine more sunlight into space. This is supposed to give the sea the urgently needed cowing. What is the desired and unwanted consequences, the atmospheric physicist Isabelle Steinke at the TU Delft researched. It belongs to an even small number of scientists in Europe who deal with large -scale climate intervention of this kind, because solar geoengineering is controversial. Wissenschaftsjournalistin Lena Ganschow begibt sich auf Spurensuche. Wie viel Konfliktpotenzial steckt in Geo-Engineering, wenn Menschen versuchen, Wetter und Klima zu beeinflussen?In Abu Dhabi ist Wettermachen kein Wunschdenken mehr, sondern langst ein Regierungsprogramm. Die Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate gehoren zu den trockensten Landern der Erde. Am Nationalen Zentrum fur Meteorologie beschrankt man sich nicht darauf, diesen Zustand zu beobachten. Im Gegenteil: Hier wird taglich nach Wolken Ausschau gehalten, die man auswringen kann, um dem Himmel etwas mehr Regen abzutrotzen. "Cloud Seeding" nennt sich diese Technik, bei der Salzpartikel in die Wolke gespruht werden, um Regentropfen zu erzeugen.Andere Lander der Region haben bereits ahnliche Programme aufgelegt, um im Ringen um die knappe Ressource Wasser nicht ins Hintertreffen zu geraten. Dabei schwingt auch die Angst mit, der Nachbar konnte einem die Regenwolken "wegnehmen". Klar ausgesprochen hat das 2018 der iranische Brigadegeneral Gholam Reza Jalali, als er Israel und anderen Landern vorwarf, seinem Land die Regenwolken wegnehmen zu wollen."Wir brauchen Governance", sagt Dr. Abdullah Mandous, Prasident des Internationalen Meteorologischen Instituts (WMO). Um Konflikte zu vermeiden, brauche es klare Regulierungen fur das Cloud Seeding.Dass Geo-Engineering auch eine sicherheitspolitische Komponente haben kann, zeigt schon seine Geschichte. 1962 startete das US-Militar unter dem Namen Stormfury ein Projekt. Es war ein Versuch, Hurrikane zu schwachen, indem man Silberjodid in die Wolken einbrachte. Von 1967 bis 1972 verspruhte die US-Airforce wahrend des Vietnamkrieges im Rahmen der geheimen Operation Popeye taglich Blei- und Silberjodidpulver in Monsunwolken mit dem Ziel, Regenfalle zu verstarken, um die Nachschublinien des Vietcongs auf dem Ho-Chi-Minh-Pfad zu unterbrechen.Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler bezweifeln allerdings, ob diese Methode wirklich wirksam ist. Denn Wolken sind komplex und im Detail noch nicht gut genug verstanden, wie ein Besuch auf der Schweizer Forschungsstation Erisiwil zeigt. Dort entwickeln Meteorologinnen und Meteorologen von der ETH Zurich gerade neue Methoden, um die Entstehung von Niederschlag zu erforschen. Dazu testen sie einen Wetterballon, mit dem sich in der Wolke beobachten lasst, wie beim Cloud Seeding Eiskristalle um die Kleinstpartikel wachsen.Das ist noch Grundlagenforschung. Sie warnen vor moglichen unerwunschten Konsequenzen - sowohl fur die Politik als auch furs Klima. Vor allem jene Methoden, die nicht nur das lokale Wetter, sondern potenziell das globale Klima beeinflussen konnen, werden heftig diskutiert. Denn die Folgen sind zum Teil schwer kalkulierbar.Eine davon heiSSt Marine Cloud Brightening. Die Grundidee ist bestechend: Mit harmlosem Salzwasser, das fein zerstaubt wird, will man die Wolken uber dem Meer heller machen, sodass sie mehr Sonnenlicht ins All zuruckstrahlen. Das soll dem Meer die dringend benotigte Kuhlung verschaffen. Mit welchen gewollten und ungewollten Folgen man dabei zu rechnen hatte, das erforscht die Atmospharenphysikerin Isabelle Steinke an der TU Delft. Sie gehort zu einer noch recht kleinen Zahl an Wissenschaftlerinnen in Europa, die sich mit groSS angelegten Klimainterventionen dieser Art befassen, denn solares Geoengineering ist umstritten.Auch Claudia Wieners von der Universitat Utrecht wird fur ihre Forschung von manchen Kollegen skeptisch beaugt. Sie befasst sich mit der wohl umstrittensten Methode des Geoengineering, bei der Schwefeldioxid in der Stratosphare verteilt wird, um Sonnenstrahlen zuruckzuwerfen, bevor sie in die Erdatmosphare eindringen.Nicht nur fur die Klimaforschung, auch fur das Militar ist Geoengineering langst ein Thema. Annika Vergin vom Dezernat fur Zukunftsanalyse der Bundeswehr gewahrt "ARD Wissen" Einblick in verschiedene Szenarien, in denen Geoengineering auch zum Konfliktfaktor werden konnte. Ähnlich wie im Weltraum gibt es auch hier "Dual Use"-Komponenten, also Technologien, die sowohl zivil als auch militarisch nutzbar sind. Ein Kampf ums Klima gehort zu den Szenarien, mit denen die Bundeswehr sich auseinandersetzen muss, meint Zukunftsforscherin Vergin.Im Verlauf des Films hort Lena Ganschow immmer wieder die Forderung nach politischer Regulierung. Aber warum eigentlich? Der Politologe Stefan Schafer vom Helmholtz-Zentrum in Potsdam befasst sich seit seiner Promotion mit Geoengineering. Er fuhrt vor Augen, wie weit die politischen Forderungen der Wissenschaft mit den politischen Realitaten auseinanderliegen.
