programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Chicago
programme.desc: In the new documentary series "Hardcore Pawn Chicago", everything revolves around the everyday life of the wealthy Cohen family, which have one of the greatest and oldest pawns in "Windy City". The two brother Randy and Wayne Cohen are mainly the owners of the "Royal Pawn Shop", and their children are also involved in Elys and Nate. The family members do not always agree when it comes to the best deals. The Cohens' customers could not be more different: from the Sussen children's gartner to unscrupulous managers, everything is included. / In der neuen Doku-Serie "Hardcore Pawn Chicago" dreht sich alles um den Alltag der wohlhabenden Familie Cohen, die eines der groSSten und altesten Pfandleihhauser in "Windy City" besitzen. Eigentumer des "Royal Pawn Shop" sind vor allem die beiden Bruder Randy und Wayne Cohen, daruber hinaus sind auch deren Kinder Elyse und Nate in die Geschafte involviert. Die Familienmitglieder sind sich nicht immer einig, wenn es um die besten Deals geht. Die Kundschaft der Cohens konnte nicht unterschiedlicher sein: Von der suSSen Kindergartnerin bis zum skrupellosen Manager ist alles dabei.

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.sub-title: Hau the Lukas / Hau den Lukas
programme.desc: Storage space auctions are just fun? Not for Brandon Bernie and his wife Lori. The two trips from auction to auction - across the USA, always on the hunt for cheap snaps. Because in the United States, anyone, the storage room is required, can rent a "storage unit" and accommodate their private objects there. However, if the rent is not paid, the content is auctioned - and true treasures can hide in the storage rooms. Bernie and Lori want to get these treasures: they risk a lot, the competition with the locals is hard and the two are not given anything at the auctions. Is this always worthwhile - or do the opponents only want to drive the price into the high? / Lagerraum-Auktionen sind nur SpaSS? Nicht fur Brandon Bernie und seine Ehefrau Lori. Die beiden reisen von Auktion zu Auktion - quer durch die USA, immer auf der Jagd nach gunstigen Schnappchen. Denn in den USA kann jeder, der Lagerraum benotigt, eine "storage unit" anmieten und dort seine privaten Gegenstande unterbringen. Wird allerdings die Miete nicht gezahlt, kommt es zur Versteigerung des Inhalts - und in den Lagerraumen konnen sich wahre Schatze verstecken. Diese Schatze wollen Bernie und Lori ergattern: Sie riskieren viel, der Wettbewerb mit den einheimischen Mitbietern ist hart und die beiden bekommen bei den Auktionen nichts geschenkt. Ob sich dies immer lohnt - oder wollen die Kontrahenten nur den Preis in die Hohe treiben?

programme.title: Container Wars
programme.desc: From now on, it is also made in the port: In the new series "Container Wars", the content of large ship containers from all over the world comes under the hammer. In this rapid business, however, not only a thick wallet is needed, but also a good eye and iron nerves to be successful. The auctioners only have a few minutes to get a first impression of the container. Therefore, you only know after the auction whether it was worth it or not. John Kunkle, who always has one or the other saying ready. The Israeli entrepreneur duo Shlomi and Uzi, the charming Sudlander Jason, the two Californians Ty and Mo, the experienced Matthew and the former Schonheitkonigin Deana, who wants to assert himself in the manner, are entitled to the bidders. / Ab sofort werden auch im Hafen Geschafte gemacht: In der neuen Serie "Container Wars" kommt der Inhalt von groSSen Schiffscontainern aus der ganzen Welt unter den Hammer. In diesem rasanten Business braucht es allerdings nicht nur einen dicken Geldbeutel, sondern auch ein gutes Auge und eiserne Nerven, um Erfolg zu haben. Den Auktionaren bleiben nur wenige Minuten, um sich einen ersten Eindruck vom Inhalt der Container zu verschaffen. Daher weiSS man auch erst nach der Versteigerung, ob sich das Geschaft gelohnt hat oder nicht. Die Auktionen ubernimmt die lokale Beruhmtheit John Kunkle, der immer den einen oder anderen Spruch parat hat. Zu den Bietern gehoren das israelische Unternehmer-Duo Shlomi und Uzi, der charmante Sudlander Jason, die beiden Kalifornier Ty und Mo, der erfahrene Matthew und die ehemalige Schonheitskonigin Deana, die sich in der Mannerdomane behaupten will.

programme.title: Triebwerk - the automail magazine with Tim Schrick / Triebwerk - Das Automagazin mit Tim Schrick
programme.desc: In the new format "engine" with motor expert and racing driver Tim Schrick, everything is about the car. In addition to contributions, news and compact reports on current vehicles, the Automagazin produced by EVO 7 GmbH also has exciting youngtimer stories with Alex Wesselsky. "Petrolhead" Schrick always goes to different road trips for the show, but a lot also takes place on Bilster Berg: the demanding race track is his home base and how created for real hard tests. "Triebwerk- The Automagazin with Tim Schrick" is pretended by Climair, the manufacturer of high-quality car accessories such as car sun protection and wind and rainproof. With this format, the moderator celebrates its comeback on Sport1. Before that, Tim made a name for himself with a lot of know-how, wit and charm on Sport1 or previously in the DSF, among other things through cult programs such as "Turbo" and "DSF Motor". Alex Wesselsky was also used for Sport1 with the "Order Auto" format. / Im neuen Format "Triebwerk" mit Motorexperte und Rennfahrer Tim Schrick dreht sich alles rund ums Auto. Neben Beitragen, News und kompakten Reportagen zu aktuellen Fahrzeugen hat das von der EVO 7 GmbH produzierte Automagazin auch spannende Youngtimer-Stories mit Alex Wesselsky zu bieten. "Petrolhead" Schrick begibt sich fur die Sendung immer wieder auf verschiedene Roadtrips, vieles spielt sich aber auch am Bilster Berg ab: Die anspruchsvolle Rennstrecke ist seine Homebase und wie geschaffen fur echte Hartetests. "Triebwerk - Das Automagazin mit Tim Schrick" wird von ClimAir, dem Hersteller von hochwertigem Autozubehor wie Pkw-Sonnenschutz und Wind- and Regenabweisern, prasentiert. Mit diesem Format feiert der Moderator sein Comeback auf SPORT1. Davor machte Tim sich mit jeder Menge Knowhow, Witz und Charme auf SPORT1 bzw. zuvor im DSF bereits unter anderem durch Kultsendungen wie "TURBO" und "DSF Motor" einen Namen beim TV-Publikum. Auch Alex Wesselsky war mit dem Format "Auftrag Auto" ebenfalls schon fur SPORT1 im Einsatz.

programme.title: EXATLON Germany - Die Mega Challenge
programme.desc: Exatlon Germany - Who faces the ultimate hard test in the Caribbean? The globally successful sports reality format Exatlon comes to Germany-and is now on Sport1 in prime time. Exatlon is the energetic sports reality format that has already captivated numerous spectators worldwide. In front of the breathtaking backdrop of the Caribbean, the show promises a gripping spectacle that combines the tension of high-carate sports reality with first-class entertainment. Sport1, known for high-class sports content, now brings Exatlon Germany onto the screen and combines intensive body challenges Jochen Stutzky moderated. Numerous athletes and prominent meet each other in order to push their limits in two teams in the hardest competition in the world. The participants get in a number of excessive obstacle courses, which test their body and emotional strong testing - produces in the Dominican Republic. In the spotlight: the challenging competition and the great emotions of the participants, all of whom let participate in their adventures. / EXATLON Germany - wer stellt sich dem ultimativen Hartetest in der Karibik? Das global erfolgreiche Sport-Reality-Format EXATLON kommt nach Deutschland - und lauft ab sofort auf SPORT1 in der Primetime. programme.desc: Storage space auctions are just fun? Not for Brandon Bernie and his wife Lori. The two trips from auction to auction - across the USA, always on the hunt for cheap snaps. programme.title: aspekte
programme.sub-title: Nothing going on in the village - or? - How culture the province - Starkt / Nix los aufm Dorf - oder doch? - Wie Kultur die Provinz - starkt
programme.desc: When the last shop closes, more is lost than infrastructure: art, music and theater ensure social cohesion in many villages. In the area, more and more people are relying on art, theater and music in order to counteract social junction. Culture brings life, creates meeting places and strongly creates the cooperation - for its village, for the community. Ob in Lower Saxony, Mecklenburg -Western Pomerania or Austria: Creative projects show how culture can give new impulses for land. The free theater collective of village square, meadows and courtyard - where there is otherwise a lack of cultural offers. This creates a space for encounter and dialogue - also in regions that are increasingly being characterized by popular settlers. For 15 years. What once started as a small project is today an internationally observed art format in the middle of the Alps. There is a creative use of vacancy - urban art finds its way into land. The Festival Mecklenburg -Western Pomerania make music tangible in unexpected places: in Dorfkirchen, Gutshofen and remote barns. The result is more than a festival - a lively cultural network for the entire region. Many land areas suffer from emigration and vacancy, the people there from a loneliness. Politicians have recognized this and has been calling for 30 regions with a total of 45 million euros since 2025 - to stiffen cultural life in the country. But culture can loosen structural problems and revive Dorfer? Katty Salie follows these questions. / Wenn der letzte Laden schlieSSt, ist mehr verloren als Infrastruktur: Kunst, Musik und Theater sichern in vielen Dorfern den sozialen Zusammenhalt.Im landlichen Raum setzen immer mehr Menschen auf Kunst, Theater und Musik, um dem gesellschaftlichen Ruckzug entgegenzuwirken. Kultur bringt Leben zuruck, schafft Treffpunkte und starkt das Miteinander - fur ihr Dorf, fur sich, fur die Gemeinschaft.Ob in Niedersachsen, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern oder Österreich: Kreative Projekte zeigen, wie Kultur neue Impulse fur den landlichen Raum geben kann.In Bostelwiebeck tourt das Jahrmarkttheater mit mobiler Buhne durch die Luneburger Heide. Mit kraftvollen Inszenierungen bespielt das freie Theaterkollektiv Dorfplatze, Wiesen und Hofe - dort, wo sonst kulturelle Angebote fehlen.So entsteht ein Raum fur Begegnung und Dialog - auch in Regionen, die zunehmend von volkischen Siedlern gepragt werden.In Bad Gastein verwandelt die Kunstmeile leer stehende Grandhotels in Galerien. Seit 15 Jahren schon. Was einst als kleines Projekt begann, ist heute ein international beachtetes Kunstformat mitten in den Alpen. Dort wird Leerstand kreativ genutzt - urbane Kunst findet ihren Weg ins Landliche.Die Festspiele Mecklenburg-Vorpommern machen Musik an unerwarteten Orten erlebbar: in Dorfkirchen, Gutshofen und abgelegenen Scheunen. Entstanden ist mehr als ein Festival - ein lebendiges Kulturnetzwerk fur die gesamte Region.Viele landliche Gebiete leiden unter Abwanderung und Leerstand, die Menschen dort unter Vereinsamung. Die Politik hat das erkannt und fordert seit dem Jahr 2025 30 Regionen mit insgesamt 45 Millionen Euro - zur Starkung des kulturellen Lebens auf dem Land. Doch kann Kultur strukturelle Probleme losen und Dorfer wiederbeleben?Diesen Fragen geht Katty Salie nach.

programme.title: The valley of the dead girls / Das Tal der toten Madchen
programme.desc: The body of a young person is found in a foggy valley of northern Spain. It quickly becomes clear that a serial killer is up to mischief. The young commissioner Amaia determines. The corpses are cleaned and staged as saints. When another girl disappears, a race against time begins. The Spanish commissioner Amaia Salazar (Marta Etura) takes over the investigation in a bizarre murder: in a valley near her hometown, the tranquil Basque town of Elizondo, the body of a young person is found. It was pulled out, cleaned ritually and placed on the forest floor like a saint. In addition, there was a traditional Basque baking on her body - a Txantxigorri. This pattern fits a murder case that occurred a few weeks earlier, and Amaia is gradually realizing that she is dealing with a serial killer. Together with her partner Jonan Etxaide (Carlos Librado Nene), she takes up the investigation and returns to the place that she actually wanted to escape forever. But her dangerous opponent is always one step ahead of her. The media give the mysterious killer the name Basajaún, a forest spirit from the mythology of the Basque Country. And some of the villagers actually begin to believe in this superior explanation for the murders. But Amaia is convinced that it is a murder of flesh and blood. In addition to everything, Amaia also has to get with private problems: she neglects her husband James (Benn Northover), with whom she desperately wishes to do a child. And in Elizondo she meets her oldest sister Flora (Elvira Mínguez) after many years, who now heads the family business and with which she is in a dispute. Flora simply cannot forgive Amaia that she was not grief for the sick mother, but once left the Basque Country for her training. After all, more girls disappear, a race against time begins. And it is becoming more and more obvious that the murders could also have something to do with their own family history. The writer Dolores Redondo, born in 1969, pays the most successful crime writers in her home country of Spain. With the so-called Bazn trilogy, she set a literary monument to the Basque Country with its idiosyncratic residents, enchanted fog valley and legendary myths. In Germany, the novels under the titles "A Echo Ferner Tag", "The Forgotten Children" and "The Night Visit" appeared. With this success, it was only a matter of time before the trilogy was planned. Fernando González Molina, who landed a big cinema in Spain with the historical drama "Palmen in the Snow", was directed by Fernando González Molina. "El Guardián Invisible" (so the original title of "The Valley of the Dead Madchen"), which was created in co -production with ZDF and Arte, became a great success. which suddenly became a star with this role in her home country. Although she was able to draw attention to the side of Spain's most prominent character head, Luis Tosar, in the films "Sleep Tight" and "Cell 211", but the role of the sensitive profiler seemed to be literally written on her body. / In einem nebligen Tal Nordspaniens wird die Leiche einer Jugendlichen gefunden. Schnell wird klar, dass ein Serienkiller sein Unwesen treibt. Die junge Kommissarin Amaia ermittelt.Es scheint sich um einen Ritualmorder zu handeln, der stets nach dem gleichen Muster verfahrt. Die Leichen werden gereinigt und als Heilige inszeniert. Als ein weiteres Madchen verschwindet, beginnt ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit.Die spanische Kommissarin Amaia Salazar (Marta Etura) ubernimmt die Ermittlungen in einem bizarren Mordfall: In einem Tal unweit ihres Heimatortes, dem beschaulichen baskischen Stadtchen Elizondo, wird die Leiche einer Jugendlichen gefunden. Sie wurde ausgezogen, rituell gereinigt und von ihrem Morder wie eine Heilige inszeniert auf dem Waldboden platziert. AuSSerdem lag auf ihrem Korper ein traditionelles baskisches Geback - ein Txantxigorri.Dieses Muster passt zu einem Mordfall, der sich bereits einige Wochen zuvor ereignet hat, und Amaia realisiert allmahlich, dass sie es mit einem Serienkiller zu tun hat. Gemeinsam mit ihrem Partner Jonan Etxaide (Carlos Librado Nene) nimmt sie die Ermittlungen auf und kehrt in jenen Ort zuruck, dem sie eigentlich fur immer entfliehen wollte. Doch ihr gefahrlicher Gegner ist ihr stets einen Schritt voraus.Die Medien geben dem geheimnisvollen Killer den Namen Basajaún, ein Waldgeist aus der Mythologie des Baskenlandes. Und einige der Dorfbewohner beginnen tatsachlich, an diese ubernaturliche Erklarung fur die Morde zu glauben. Doch Amaia ist davon uberzeugt, dass es sich um einen Morder aus Fleisch und Blut handelt.Zu allem Überfluss hat Amaia auch noch mit privaten Problemen zu kampfen: Sie vernachlassigt ihren Ehemann James (Benn Northover), mit dem sie sich verzweifelt ein Kind wunscht. Und in Elizondo trifft sie nach vielen Jahren wieder auf ihre alteste Schwester Flora (Elvira Mínguez), die inzwischen das Familienunternehmen leitet und mit der sie im Streit liegt. Flora kann Amaia einfach nicht verzeihen, dass sie sich nicht um die kranke Mutter kummerte, sondern fur ihre Ausbildung einst das Baskenland verlieSS.Als schlieSSlich weitere Madchen verschwinden, beginnt fur Amaia ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit. Und es wird immer offensichtlicher, dass die Morde auch etwas mit ihrer eigenen Familiengeschichte zu tun haben konnten.Die 1969 geborene Schriftstellerin Dolores Redondo zahlt in ihrem Heimatland Spanien zu den erfolgreichsten Krimiautorinnen. Mit der sogenannten Baztán-Trilogie setzte sie dem Baskenland mit seinen eigenwilligen Bewohnern, verwunschenen Nebeltalern und legendenumrankten Mythen ein literarisches Denkmal. In Deutschland erschienen die Romane unter den Titeln "Ein Echo ferner Tage", "Die vergessenen Kinder" und "Der nachtliche Besucher".Bei diesem Erfolg war es nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis eine Verfilmung der Trilogie geplant wurde. Die Regie fur Teil eins ubernahm Fernando González Molina, der mit dem Historiendrama "Palmen im Schnee" einen groSSen Kinohit in Spanien landete. Auch "El Guardián Invisible" (so der Originaltitel von "Das Tal der toten Madchen"), der in Koproduktion mit dem ZDF und ARTE entstand, wurde zu einem groSSen Erfolg.Die Hauptrolle der couragierten Inspektorin Amaia Salazar, die sich nicht nur mit einem brutalen Serienkiller konfrontiert sieht, sondern auch mit den Damonen ihrer eigenen Vergangenheit, spielt die Baskin Marta Etura, die mit dieser Rolle in ihrem Heimatland schlagartig zum Star wurde. Zwar konnte sie schon an der Seite von Spaniens prominentestem Charakterkopf, Luis Tosar, in den Kinofilmen "Sleep Tight" und "Zelle 211" auf sich aufmerksam machen, doch die Rolle der sensiblen Profilerin schien ihr regelrecht auf den Leib geschrieben zu sein.

programme.title: How long can you still keep the appearance? / Wie lange kannst du den Schein noch wahren?
programme.sub-title: Do you shame yourself for your depression? / Schamst du dich fur deine Depression?
programme.desc: Christian Durstewitz lived from his music. Then he got a depression. He shaped himself, said concerts, invented excuses for canceling. He speaks to Jasmina Neudecker about this time. A shrill whistle in the ear and the feeling of being dead inside. But he didn't want to believe that he suffered from a mental illness. Self -level - almost like a second illness. How do we break down prejudices and meet those affected with acceptance. But then the break came: a severe depression tore him out of everyday life. There was hard to think about appearances or creative work. For fear of rejection and out of shame, Christian began to tell excuses to cancel concerts - headache, stomach problems - everything was easier to explain than the true cause. Biologist Jasmina Neudecker wants to understand what is behind this feeling - a feel that many people with mental illnesses know too well: shame. In 2022, depression was diagnosed in 12.5 percent of German population and many of them were similar to Christian. This so -called self -sigma makes it even more difficult to accept help and to speak openly about their situation. Nicolas Rusch from the Ulm University Clinic even calls a "second illness". Because while boring symptoms often cause fellow chair or even humor - a plaster leg quickly becomes a party history - a stay in psychiatry usually remains a taboo. So how can we dismantle prejudices and encounter mental illnesses with the same openness as corporate suffering? / Christian Durstewitz lebte von seiner Musik. Dann bekam er eine Depression. Er schamte sich, sagte Konzerte ab, erfand Ausreden fur Absagen. Mit Jasmina Neudecker spricht er uber diese Zeit.Ein schrilles Pfeifen im Ohr und das Gefuhl, innerlich tot zu sein. Doch dass er an einer psychischen Erkrankung litt, wollte er nicht glauben. Selbststigma - fast wie eine zweite Krankheit. Wie bauen wir Vorurteile ab und begegnen Betroffenen mit Akzeptanz.Christian Durstewitz konnte nach seinem dritten Platz beim deutschen Vorentscheid zum Eurovision Song Contest 2010 endlich von seiner Musik leben. Doch dann kam der Bruch: Eine schwere Depression riss ihn aus dem Alltag. An Auftritte oder kreative Arbeit war kaum noch zu denken. Aus Angst vor Ablehnung und aus Scham begann Christian, Ausreden zu erfinden, um Konzerte absagen zu konnen- Kopfschmerzen, Magenprobleme - alles war leichter zu erklaren als die wahre Ursache.Biologin Jasmina Neudecker will verstehen, was hinter diesem Gefuhl steckt - einem Gefuhl, das viele Menschen mit psychischen Erkrankungen nur zu gut kennen: Scham. Im Jahr 2022 wurde bei 12,5 Prozent der deutschen Bevolkerung eine Depression diagnostiziert und vielen davon ging es ahnlich wie Christian. Dieses sogenannte Selbststigma macht es Betroffenen noch schwerer, Hilfe anzunehmen und offen uber ihre Situation zu sprechen.Prof. Nicolas Rusch von der Universitatsklinik Ulm nennt das Stigma sogar eine "zweite Krankheit". Denn wahrend korperliche Beschwerden oft Mitgefuhl oder sogar Humor hervorrufen - ein Gipsbein wird schnell zur Partygeschichte - bleibt ein Aufenthalt in der Psychiatrie meist ein Tabu. Wie also konnen wir Vorurteile abbauen und psychische Erkrankungen mit der gleichen Offenheit begegnen wie korperlichen Leiden?

What did the traders do with it? There is now the answer. In "Bares for Rares - Handler Stucks", the focus is on the further career of the objects. And how is the price redesigning? This makes an old, unadorned children's cradle a colorful eye-catcher, a 4-carat ring turns into two new jewelry stucco, and a few old skis are upgraded to a unusual table. / Bei "Bares fur Rares" wurde schon so manches Geheimnis geluftet, und unzahlige Antiquitaten wechselten im Handlerraum den Besitzer.Doch immer wieder kommt die Frage auf, was eigentlich nach dem Verkauf mit den Objekten passiert. Was haben die Handler damit gemacht? Darauf gibt es nun die Antwort. Bei "Bares fur Rares - Handlerstucke" wird der Fokus auf den weiteren Werdegang der Objekte gelegt.Wie wird ein Stuck aufgearbeitet, wie viel Aufwand steckt dahinter, und wie hoch sind die Kosten? Und wie gestaltet sich anschlieSSend der Preis neu?So wird aus einer alten, schmucklosen Kinderwiege ein bunter Eyecatcher, ein 4-Karat-Ring verwandelt sich in zwei neue Schmuckstucke, und ein Paar alte Ski werden zu einem ausgefallenen Tisch upgecycelt.

programme.title: How long can you still keep the appearance? / Wie lange kannst du den Schein noch wahren?
programme.sub-title: Do you shame yourself for your depression? / Schamst du dich fur deine Depression?
programme.desc: Christian Durstewitz lived from his music. Then he got a depression. He shaped himself, said concerts, invented excuses for canceling. He speaks to Jasmina Neudecker about this time. A shrill whistle in the ear and the feeling of being dead inside. But he didn't want to believe that he suffered from a mental illness. Self -level - almost like a second illness. How do we break down prejudices and meet those affected with acceptance. But then the break came: a severe depression tore him out of everyday life. There was hard to think about appearances or creative work. For fear of rejection and out of shame, Christian began to tell excuses to cancel concerts - headache, stomach problems - everything was easier to explain than the true cause. Biologist Jasmina Neudecker wants to understand what is behind this feeling - a feel that many people with mental illnesses know too well: shame. In 2022, depression was diagnosed in 12.5 percent of German population and many of them were similar to Christian. This so -called self -sigma makes it even more difficult to accept help and to speak openly about their situation. Nicolas Rusch from the Ulm University Clinic even calls a "second illness". Because while boring symptoms often cause fellow chair or even humor - a plaster leg quickly becomes a party history - a stay in psychiatry usually remains a taboo. So how can we dismantle prejudices and encounter mental illnesses with the same openness as corporate suffering? / Christian Durstewitz lebte von seiner Musik. Dann bekam er eine Depression. Er schamte sich, sagte Konzerte ab, erfand Ausreden fur Absagen. Mit Jasmina Neudecker spricht er uber diese Zeit.Ein schrilles Pfeifen im Ohr und das Gefuhl, innerlich tot zu sein. Doch dass er an einer psychischen Erkrankung litt, wollte er nicht glauben. Selbststigma - fast wie eine zweite Krankheit. Wie bauen wir Vorurteile ab und begegnen Betroffenen mit Akzeptanz.Christian Durstewitz konnte nach seinem dritten Platz beim deutschen Vorentscheid zum Eurovision Song Contest 2010 endlich von seiner Musik leben. Doch dann kam der Bruch: Eine schwere Depression riss ihn aus dem Alltag. An Auftritte oder kreative Arbeit war kaum noch zu denken. Aus Angst vor Ablehnung und aus Scham begann Christian, Ausreden zu erfinden, um Konzerte absagen zu konnen- Kopfschmerzen, Magenprobleme - alles war leichter zu erklaren als die wahre Ursache.Biologin Jasmina Neudecker will verstehen, was hinter diesem Gefuhl steckt - einem Gefuhl, das viele Menschen mit psychischen Erkrankungen nur zu gut kennen: Scham. Im Jahr 2022 wurde bei 12,5 Prozent der deutschen Bevolkerung eine Depression diagnostiziert und vielen davon ging es ahnlich wie Christian. Dieses sogenannte Selbststigma macht es Betroffenen noch schwerer, Hilfe anzunehmen und offen uber ihre Situation zu sprechen.Prof. Nicolas Rusch von der Universitatsklinik Ulm nennt das Stigma sogar eine "zweite Krankheit". Denn wahrend korperliche Beschwerden oft Mitgefuhl oder sogar Humor hervorrufen - ein Gipsbein wird schnell zur Partygeschichte - bleibt ein Aufenthalt in der Psychiatrie meist ein Tabu. Wie also konnen wir Vorurteile abbauen und psychische Erkrankungen mit der gleichen Offenheit begegnen wie korperlichen Leiden?

Every day from May to October, ships lie in front of their home. "I get up with an oppressive feeling in the morning," explains Ingrid. The ships right in front of their home are not only bad for their view, but also for the historical building and their health. How full of it can only be used for 40 minutes from stavanger. Here is the price of the price - confessional in German. The founded rock is also the goal of Yvonne and Robert. You do a tour with Melanie Uhl. German has been living in Norway for a year and runs up with tourists up to three times a week. Most come for the photo on the edge of the rock, which drops 604 meters steeply into the fjord. When the weather is good, creeping is guaranteed here. To avoid this, Åsmund Bakke only offers tours in small groups on the follow-up gefonna glacier in Jondal. Nevertheless, demand has increased significantly in recent years. A balancing act for the team around Åsmund, because on the one hand they live from the tourists - on the other hand, a strong increase in flight and ship trips find the climate and thus the glacier. He is director of the Bryggen Foundation in Bergen. The historic harbor district is UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most popular places in the Kustenstadt. Martin Piehler's city -based also ends in the Basic quarter. "In July it is sometimes so full that you can hardly walk," said Piehler. And not everyone behaves respectfully. According to Øyen, there are currently discussion of the visitor limitation. Some residents in the small town of Flåm am Aurlandsfjord were probably pleased about a visitor limitation. Especially on days on which a cruise ship is located in the harbor, the 288-soul village becomes the purest Disneyland. One of the main rounds: nature and the Flåmbahn. It is considered one of the most beautiful train trips in the world and ensures that up to 450,000 tourists come to Flåm. Yvonne, Robert and son Paul are also here. But is the still natural, relaxed trip? The "ZDF. Reportage" accompanies German campers and tourists on their journey through Sudnorwegen and shows how the locals experience the tourist rush. / Norwegen statt Malle. Immer mehr Touristen reisen in den Norden, denn am Mittelmeer wird es im Sommer immer heiSSer. Droht dem Norden jetzt der Übertourismus?2024 war mit fast 38,6 Millionen Übernachtungen fur Norwegen ein Rekordjahr. Temperaturen von 18 bis 25 Grad, eine Vielzahl an Campingmoglichkeiten, Kulinarik, Kultur, Nightlife und einzigartige Wanderziele sind verlockend - aber der Ansturm birgt auch Konflikte.Bei Per Arne Haarr auf dem Campingplatz in Stavanger ist es in der Hauptsaison normal, dass er und sein Team ab dem fruhen Nachmittag Touristen abweisen mussen. Reservieren kann man auf dem Platz mitten in der Stadt nicht. Auch deswegen sind Robert, Yvonne und Sohn Paul extra fruh angereist. Die Familie aus dem Schwarzwald ist das zweite Mal in Norwegen. "Das erste Mal haben wir eine Tour mit dem Motorrad ans Nordkap gemacht", so Yvonne. Dieses Mal mochten sie die Hotspots im Suden erleben. Doch schnell zeigt sich, dort ist es mittlerweile um einiges voller als vor sechs Jahren.Einsamkeit in der Natur Norwegens sucht man hier vergebens. Wer Trubel mag, kommt aber in den Kneipenmeilen, der so genannten Fargegatan und an der Hafenpromenade, voll auf seine Kosten. Dazu kommen die Kreuzfahrtschiffe. Bis zu drei davon konnen in Stavanger gleichzeitig liegen und schwemmen so taglich tausende Touristen in die Stadt.Sehr zum Leidwesen von Anwohnern wie Knut und Ingrid. Sie wohnen in der Altstadt, dem so genannten Gamle Stavanger. Jeden Tag von Mai bis Oktober liegen Schiffe vor ihrer Haustur."Ich stehe morgens schon mit einem beklemmenden Gefuhl auf", erzahlt Ingrid. Die Schiffe direkt vor ihrer Haustur seien nicht nur schlecht fur ihre Aussicht, sondern auch fur die historischen Gebaude und ihre Gesundheit.Wie voll es wirklich werden kann, zeigt sich nur 40 Minuten von Stavanger entfernt. Hier liegt der Preikestolen - Beichtstuhl zu Deutsch. Der beruhmte Fels ist auch das Ziel von Yvonne und Robert. Sie machen eine Tour mit Melanie Uhl. Die Deutsche lebt seit einem Jahr in Norwegen und lauft bis zu dreimal die Woche mit Touristen hier hoch. Die meisten kommen fur das Foto am Rand des Felsens, der 604 Meter steil in den Fjord abfallt. Bei gutem Wetter ist Schlangestehen hier garantiert.Um das zu vermeiden, bietet Åsmund Bakke auf dem Folgefonna-Gletscher in Jondal nur Touren in kleinen Gruppen an. Trotzdem ist die Nachfrage in den letzten Jahren stark gestiegen. Fur das Team um Åsmund ein Balanceakt, denn zum einen leben sie von den Touristen - zum anderen gefahrdet ein starker Anstieg von Flug- und Schiffsreisen das Klima und somit den Gletscher.Die richtige Balance finden, ist auch das Thema von Bernt Hårvard Øyen. Er ist Direktor der Stiftung Bryggen in Bergen. Das historische Hafenviertel ist UNESCO Weltkulturerbe und einer der beliebtesten Orte in der Kustenstadt. Auch die Stadtfuhrung von Martin Piehler endet in dem beruhmten Viertel. "Im Juli ist es hier manchmal so voll, dass man kaum laufen kann", so Piehler. Und nicht alle benehmen sich respektvoll. Laut Øyen wird derzeit uber Moglichkeiten der Besucherbegrenzung diskutiert.Über eine Besucherbegrenzung wurde sich wohl mancher Anwohner in dem kleinen Stadtchen Flåm am Aurlandsfjord freuen. Gerade an Tagen, an denen ein Kreuzfahrtschiff im Hafen liegt, wird aus dem 288-Seelen-Dorf das reinste Disneyland. Einer der Hauptgrunde: die Natur und die Flåmbahn. Sie gilt als eine der schonsten Zugreisen der Welt und sorgt dafur, dass bis zu 450.000 Touristen nach Flåm kommen. Auch Yvonne, Robert und Sohn Paul sind deswegen hier. Doch ist das noch naturnahes, entspanntes Reisen?Die "ZDF.reportage" begleitet deutsche Camper und Touristen auf ihrer Reise durch Sudnorwegen und zeigt, wie die Einheimischen den Touristenansturm erleben.

programme.title: Spanish football championship / Ισπανικό Πρωτάθλημα Ποδοσφαίρου
programme.desc: Better Backs 2024/25. The goals are just as important as repulsions, so we remember the best interventions of La Liga goalkeepers. programme.title: Spanish football championship / Ισπανικό Πρωτάθλημα Ποδοσφαίρου
programme.desc: Review of season. The show summarizes everything that happened during the 2024/25 season in La Liga. Θα θυμηθούμε τις πιο σημαντικές στιγμές και όλα τα στατιστικά κάθε αγωνιστικής, τους MVP και τα τρία καλύτερα γκολ κάθε μήνα.

(120)

Ο αυστηρός στρατιωτικός και η επαναστατημένη σύζυγος δεν αντέχουν ο ένας τον άλλον και οι καβγάδες ξεκινούν αμέσως.

programme.title: Perimeter / Περίμετρος

programme.title: Save our forests E3 (e) / Σώστε τα Δάση μας Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Battle against monoculture. The story of a Frenchman and a German who promote sustainable forestry and show us that there are healthy deforestation methods. / Επεισόδιο: Μάχη Ενάντια στη Μονοκαλλιέργεια. Η ιστορία ενός Γάλλου και μιας Γερμανίδας που προωθούν τη βιώσιμη δασοκομία και μας δείχνουν ότι υπάρχουν υγιείς μέθοδοι αποψίλωσης.

programme.title: From the field to the shelf K1 E12 (E) / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ1 Ε12 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Rice. The show went to Chalastra in West Thessaloniki, where, once a year, most of this fertile plain is deliberately flooded with huge quantities of water in order to complete rice sowing. / Επεισόδιο: Ρύζι. Η εκπομπή μετέβη στη Χαλάστρας στη Δυτική Θεσσαλονίκη, όπου, μία φορά τον χρόνο, το μεγαλύτερο μέρος αυτής της εύφορης πεδιάδας πλημμυρίζει εσκεμμένα με τεράστιες ποσότητες υδάτων, προκειμένου να ολοκληρωθεί η σπορά του ρυζιού.

programme.title: Joy of God K4 (e) / Χαρά Θεού Κ4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Panagia Sumela. The show is dedicated to the history of Pontian Hellenism, from Byzantium to its uproar by the New Turks. The looting of the Holy Monastery of Panagia Sumelas in Trabzon, and the founding of the New Monastery in Vermio. / Επεισόδιο: Παναγία Σουμελά. Η εκπομπή είναι αφιερωμένη στην ιστορία του Ποντιακού Ελληνισμού, από το Βυζάντιο ως τον ξεριζωμό του από τους Νεότουρκους. Η λεηλασία της Ιεράς Μονής Παναγίας Σουμελάς στην Τραπεζούντα, και η ίδρυση της Νέας Μονής στο Βέρμιο.

programme.title: Beautiful Italy E3 (E) / Όμορφη Ιταλία Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The Guardians of the Soil. Producers of Lake Bolshena, Gaia, Mateo, Emmanuel, Daniele and Jonathan, defend biodiversity through regenerative agriculture, craft cheese, traditional fishing and the preservation of ancient varieties. / Επεισόδιο: The Guardians of The Soil. Οι παραγωγοί της λίμνης Μπολσένα, Γκάια, Ματέο, Εμανουέλε, Ντανιέλε και Τζόναθαν, προασπίζουν τη βιοποικιλότητα μέσω της αναγεννητικής γεωργίας, της βιοτεχνικής τυροκομίας, της παραδοσιακής αλιείας και της διατήρησης αρχαίων ποικιλιών.

programme.title: The dosage / Οι Δοσατζήδες
programme.desc: Two traders open their own business. They buy their packets and with a motorcycle-shops start to turn the neighborhoods, selling in doses. Along the way, they discover that things are more difficult than they expected. (82) / Δύο εμποροϋπάλληλοι ανοίγουν δική τους επιχείρηση. Αγοράζουν με γραμμάτια την πραμάτεια τους και με μια μοτοσικλέτα-πολυκατάστημα αρχίζουν να γυρίζουν τις γειτονιές, πουλώντας με δόσεις. Στην πορεία, ανακαλύπτουν ότι τα πράγματα είναι πιο δύσκολα απ ό,τι περίμεναν. (82)

programme.title: Memories of stadiums (e) / Μνήμες Γηπέδων (Ε)
programme.desc: Yutsu was going. In the districts with the dry. Aigaleo and Atromitos Peristeri. Athletic insert. / Έμπαινε Γιούτσο. Στις Συνοικίες με τα Ξερά. Αιγάλεω και Ατρόμητος Περιστερίου. Αθλητικό ένθετο.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Start E4 (E) / STart Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Theodoros Terzopoulos - Part B. In a rare appearance, the pioneer, a worldwide artist, who closes this year with the Attis team, shares thoughts and moments from his beginning to his enormous success in Epidaurus with Oresteia. / Επεισόδιο: Θεόδωρος Τερζόπουλος - Μέρος Β. Σε μια σπάνια εμφάνιση, ο πρωτοπόρος, παγκόσμιας εμβέλειας καλλιτέχνης, που κλείνει φέτος 40 χρόνια με την ομάδα Άττις, μοιράζεται σκέψεις και στιγμές από το ξεκίνημά του μέχρι την τεράστια επιτυχία του στην Επίδαυρο με την Ορέστεια.

programme.title: Amazing trips by train K12 E6 (E) / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ12 Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Dominican Republic. The Caribbean is dreamy and our traveler is in the Dominican Republic. Although the island is not known for its rail network, Philip will find small trains hidden in Alykes or in the cane fields. / Επεισόδιο: Δομινικανική Δημοκρατία. Η Καραϊβική είναι ονειρική και ο περιηγητής μας βρίσκεται στη Δομινικανή Δημοκρατία. Αν και το νησί δεν είναι γνωστό για το σιδηροδρομικό του δίκτυο, ο Φιλίπ θα βρει μικρά τρένα κρυμμένα στις αλυκές ή στα χωράφια με τα ζαχαροκάλαμα.

programme.title: Camping History (E) / Η Ιστορία του Κάμπινγκ (Ε)
programme.desc: For over 100 years, people have been vacationing in tents or caravans. But what is so exciting about this temporary nomadism and how did the campsite become so popular? The documentary examines this question. / Για πάνω από 100 χρόνια, οι άνθρωποι κάνουν διακοπές σε σκηνές ή τροχόσπιτα. Αλλά τι είναι τόσο συναρπαστικό σε αυτόν τον προσωρινό νομαδισμό και πώς το κάμπινγκ έγινε τόσο δημοφιλές; Το ντοκιμαντέρ εξετάζει αυτό το ερώτημα.

programme.title: Christos, the last child (e) / Χρήστος, το Τελευταίο Παιδί (Ε)
programme.desc: Of the thirty inhabitants of Arkies, a windsurfing island in the Dodecanese, Christos is the last child left. He is ten years old and in order to continue in the Gymnasium he must leave his island and family. / Από τους τριάντα κατοίκους των Αρκιών, ενός ανεμοδαρμένου νησιού στα Δωδεκάνησα, ο Χρήστος είναι το τελευταίο παιδί που έχει απομείνει. Είναι δέκα ετών και για να συνεχίσει στο γυμνάσιο πρέπει να αφήσει το νησί και την οικογένεια του.

programme.title: The dust that falls / Η Σκόνη που Πέφτει
programme.desc: A journalist, although he believes his father was killed in the civil war, finds him by accident in a video and starts looking for him in northern Greece first and then in other countries. (90) / Ένας δημοσιογράφος, αν και πιστεύει ότι ο πατέρας του σκοτώθηκε στον εμφύλιο, τον εντοπίζει τυχαία σε κάποιο βίντεο και αρχίζει να τον αναζητά πρώτα στη βόρεια Ελλάδα και μετά σε άλλες χώρες. (90)

programme.title: My trip to Greece K5 E4 (E) / Το Ταξίδι μου στην Ελλάδα Κ5 Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Crete - East Coast. Η μέρα κλείνει με ένα παραδοσιακό κρητικό μπάρμπεκιου.

programme.desc: Episode: The top athlete. The eternal discussion in sport. Who is the top of all time? There, the Aborigines have managed to survive despite adverse conditions. / Επεισόδιο: Αυστραλιανό Άουτμπακ: Η Έρημος Ορυχείο. Τεράστιες περιοχές της αυστραλιανής ηπείρου καλύπτονται από έρημο. programme.title: Gala in Berlin 2022 (E) / Γκαλά στο Βερολίνο 2022 (Ε)
programme.desc: On New Year's Eve of 2022, the Berlin Philharmonic and the maestro Ciril Petrenko welcome a special guest: the top tenor Jonas Kaufman, who participates in a fascinating Italian and Russian program. / Την παραμονή της Πρωτοχρονιάς του 2022, η Φιλαρμονική του Βερολίνου και ο μαέστρος Κίριλ Πετρένκο καλωσορίζουν έναν ξεχωριστό καλεσμένο: τον κορυφαίο τενόρο Γιόνας Κάουφμαν, που συμμετέχει σε ένα συναρπαστικό ιταλικό και ρωσικό πρόγραμμα.

programme.title: Open Book K2 E10 (E) / Ανοιχτό Βιβλίο Κ2 Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: A discussion about how artificial intelligence transforms our world with writer and journalist Manolis Andriotakis, Professor of Law and Informatics Lilian Mitrou and constitutionalist Fereniki Panagopoulou-Koutnatzis. / Μια συζήτηση για το πώς η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη μεταμορφώνει τον κόσμ μας με τον συγγραφέα και δημοσιογράφο Μανώλη Ανδριωτάκη, την καθηγήτρια Δικαίου και Πληροφορικής Λίλιαν Μήτρου και τη συνταγματολόγος Φερενίκη Παναγοπούλου-Κουτνατζή.

programme.title: It's up to you K2 E2 (E) / Είναι στο Χέρι σου Κ2 Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Ilenia and Stefanos decide to build a multifunctional table for indoors and outdoors. Stefanos shows in Ilenia what is the right way to easily adjust the hinges in the kitchen cabinets. / Η Ιλένια και ο Στέφανος αποφασίζουν να φτιάξουν ένα πολυλειτουργικό τραπεζάκι για εσωτερικό και εξωτερικό χώρο. Ο Στέφανος δείχνει στην Ιλένια ποιος είναι ο σωστός τρόπος να ρυθμίσει εύκολα τους μεντεσέδες στα ντουλάπια της κουζίνας.

programme.title: Small States of Europe E6 (E) / Μικρά Κράτη της Ευρώπης Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Luxembourg. The big Duchy of Luxembourg, the southernmost and smaller of the three Benelux countries, offers natural treasures in a small area. However, population growth and pollution threaten the country's environment. / Επεισόδιο: Λουξεμβούργο. Το Μεγάλο Δουκάτο του Λουξεμβούργου, η νοτιότερη και μικρότερη από τις τρεις χώρες της Μπενελούξ, προσφέρει φυσικούς θησαυρούς σε μια μικρή περιοχή. Ωστόσο, η αύξηση του πληθυσμού και η ρύπανση απειλούν το περιβάλλον της χώρας.

programme.title: AUTO MOTO ERT (E) / Auto Moto ΕΡΤ (Ε)
programme.desc: Broadcast on motor sport, with presenters Nikos Koroviela, Nikos, Kyiotelis and Angelos Stathakopoulos. / Εκπομπή για τον μηχανοκίνητο αθλητισμό, με παρουσιαστές τους Νίκο Κορόβηλα, Νίκο Παγιωτέλη και Άγγελο Σταθακόπουλο.

Η εκπομπή εστιάζει στους ποδοσφαιριστές που αγωνίζονται για το χειροκρότημα και την τιμή του χωριού και της φανέλας.

programme.desc: Silesia (Poland). Watch the track and field competitions for the Diamond League Championship, an event that has started their career with top world track and world career, athletes who have enchanted the public around the world. / Σιλεσία (Πολωνία). Παρακολουθήστε τα αγωνίσματα στίβου για το πρωτάθλημα Diamond League, μια διοργάνωση από την οποία έχουν ξεκινήσει την καριέρα τους κορυφαία ονόματα του παγκόσμιου στίβου, αθλητές που μάγεψαν το κοινό σε ολόκληρο τον κόσμο.

programme.title: Herbs, Earth Fruit E3 (E) / Βότανα, Καρποί της Γης Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Herbs and aquariums at the University of Thessaly. What does fishing have to do with agriculture? How were fish and plants found together in the same greenhouse? An innovative research is done at the University of Thessaly with simultaneous fish farming and plant cultivation. / Επεισόδιο: Βότανα και Ενυδρειοπονία στο Πανεπιστήμιο Θεσσαλίας. Τι σχέση έχει η ιχθυοπονία με τη γεωπονία; Πώς βρέθηκαν ψάρια και φυτά μαζί στο ίδιο θερμοκήπιο; Μια πρωτοποριακή έρευνα γίνεται στο Πανεπιστήμιο Θεσσαλίας με ταυτόχρονη εκτροφή ψαριών και καλλιέργεια φυτών.

programme.desc: Episode: Europe dances Greek dances - Part A. programme.desc: Episode: Siberia. Philip fulfills one of his dreams: to discover Siberia, in the Hypotheus, with the Trans -Pacific Railway. In the journey program: Yakutsk, the coldest city in the world, the legendary Lake Baikalis and Vladivostok. / Επεισόδιο: Σιβηρία. Ο Φιλίπ πραγματοποιεί ένα από τα όνειρά του: να ανακαλύψει τη Σιβηρία, μες στο καταχείμωνο, με τον Υπερσιβηρικό Σιδηρόδρομο. Στο πρόγραμμα του ταξιδιού: το Γιακούτσκ, η πιο κρύα πόλη του κόσμου, η θρυλική λίμνη Βαϊκάλη και το Βλαδιβοστόκ.

programme.title: Under the skin E3 (e) / Κάτω Από το Δέρμα Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The demons of speed. While people are obsessed with how they will achieve even higher speeds, for the creatures of the earth that have to adapt and evolve to acquire acceleration abilities, this often means the difference between life and death. / Επεισόδιο: Οι δαίμονες της ταχύτητας. Ενώ οι άνθρωποι έχουν εμμονή με το πώς θα επιτύχουν ακόμα μεγαλύτερες ταχύτητες, για τα πλάσματα της Γης που χρειάστηκε να προσαρμοστούν και να εξελιχθούν για να αποκτήσουν ικανότητες επιτάχυνσης, αυτό συχνά σημαίνει τη διαφορά μεταξύ ζωής και θανάτου.

programme.desc: If memory is the look back in the past and the past a foreign country, then Katia's unexpected journey into the city traps her in an adventure. programme.title: Central Africa vs Tanzania - African Nations Championship - CHAN 2024 - Group Matches
programme.desc: The delayed 2024 African Nations Championship (CHAN 2024), kicked off live on Saturday, 2 August, and runs exclusively on beIN until 30 August 2025. CHAN is reserved for players active in their countries’ domestic leagues. The tournament will be staged across five venues in four cities spread across three co-hosting nations: Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 312 / MMA UFC 312
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Partizan Mozzart Bet - FMP Soccerbet, G1 / Košarka - KLS: Partizan Mozzart bet - FMP Soccerbet, G1
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Porto - Roma
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Sarajevo - Posusje / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sarajevo - Posušje
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Igokea - Partizan / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - Partizan
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: I: Babnik Tim, Koncar Jaša, Korenjak Gasper, Kužnik Nejc, Marinko Lara, Marolt Kump Jaka, Ozimič Jaša, Perme Peter, Pivk Alisa, Pučnik Belavič Brina, Ranfl Sara, Rihter Naja, Učakar Uma, Zemic Pia, Zoja Javornik, Čuček Kaja Firbcologists played monopolies and Pia escaped again. In the meantime, the apartment turned into a real polling station. programme.desc: Part 1: Walter Elias Disney, born in 1901 in Chicago, decided in childhood that it would not be similar to his authority father, whose business ventures often ended unsuccessfully. When Walt was four years old, the family moved to a small farm in the town of Marceline in Misuri. He later perpetuated this place as a symbol of idyllic childhood. Walt Disney liked to draw as a boyfriend, and at the age of 17 he returned from World War I and moved to Kansas City, where he gets a cartoonist at an advertising agency. He soon opened his studio for Laugh-O-Gram. Although the studio soon went bankrupt, Disney did not give up. He moved to Los Angeles to his brother Roy and penetrated the flowering Hollywood movie business. Studio Disney Brothers has released a new short film every 16 days. In 1928, the premiere was followed by "Steamer William". Miki Mouse has become the latest Hollywood star with him, and Walt's brother Roy has recognized in Miki's popularity licensing goods and source of revenue.walt Disney / USA / 2015 / Director: Sarah Colt. / 1. del: Walter Elias Disney, rojen leta 1901 v Chicagu, je že v otroštvu sklenil, da ne bo podoben svojemu oblastnemu očetu, katerega poslovni podvigi so se pogosto končali neuspešno. Ko je bil Walt star štiri leta, se je družina preselila na majhno kmetijo v mestecu Marceline v Misuriju. Ta kraj je pozneje ovekovečil kot simbol idiličnega otroštva. Walt Disney je že kot fant rad risal, pri komaj 17 letih pa se je vrnil iz prve svetovne vojne in se preselil v Kansas City, kjer je dobi službo risarja v oglaševalski agenciji. Kmalu je odprl svoj studio za animacijo Laugh-O-Gram. Čeprav je studio kmalu bankrotiral, Disney ni odnehal. Preselil se je v Los Angeles k bratu Royu in prodrl v cvetoči hollywoodski filmski posel. Studio Disney Brothers je vsakih 16 dni izdal nov kratki film. Leta 1928 je sledila premiera »Parnika Vilija«. Miki Miška je z njim postal najnovejši hollywoodski zvezdnik, Waltov brat Roy pa je v Mikijevi priljubljenosti prepoznal licenčno blago in vir prihodkov.WALT DISNEY / ZDA / 2015 / Režija: Sarah Colt.

programme.title: Rozinac, documentary feuilleton, Mon. / Rožinca, dokumentarni feljton, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Lapajne Alma ... The film represents the spiritual and cultural tradition of Venetian Slovenia through the intimate narrative of four poets Luise Battistig, Margherite Trusgnach, Andreine Trusgnach and Claudia Salamant, who talk about their feelings of space in which / R: Lapajne Alma... Film predstavlja duhovno in kulturno izročilo Beneške Slovenije skozi intimno pripoved štirih pesnic Luise Battistig, Margherite Trusgnach, Andreine Trusgnach in Claudije Salamant, ki spregovorijo o svojem občutenju prostora, v katere
programme.desc: In the beginning of August, when many flowers bloom on mountain slopes, it is a time when girls and wives on the slopes of Matajur in Venetian Slovenia collect flowers and knit them in large bouquets at home. Legend has it that when Mary was taken into the sky, bouquets of flowers appeared on Earth. After a centuries -old tradition, people are preparing "bushings", collecting certain types of flowers and herbs that have a therapist, magical and protective power. The mighty mountains of Velika Baba, as they called Matajur, have been carved into stubborn and persistent people, who never locked their necks. Also are Luisa Battistig, Margherita Trusnach, Andreina Trusgnach and Claudia Salamant. All four are poets who, to create and describe their experiences of tenderness, empathy, motherhood and inner strength, draw from their premises. / V začetku avgusta, ko na gorskih pobočjih zacvetijo številne rože, je čas, ko dekleta in žene na pobočjih Matajurja v Beneški Sloveniji nabirajo rože in jih doma pletejo v velike šopke. Legenda pravi, da ko je bila Marija vzeta v nebo, se je na zemlji pojavil šopke cvetlic. Po večstoletni tradiciji ljudje pripravljajo »pušjace«, zanje pobirajo določene vrste cvetlic in zelišč, ki imajo terapevstko, magično in zaščitno moč.Pobočja mogočne gore Velike Babe, kakor so imenovali Matajur, so Beneške Slovence izklesala v trdožive in vztrajne ljudi, ki pa nikoli niso zaklepali vrat pred siromakom. Takšne so tudi Luisa Battistig, Margherita Trusnach, Andreina Trusgnach in Claudia Salamant. Vse štiri so pesnice, ki moč za ustvarjanje in opisovanje svojih izkušenj nežnosti, empatije, materinstva in notranje moči, črpajo iz svojih prostorov.

programme.title: Aloud!: Miljenko Jergovic, Mon. / NaGlas!: Miljenko Jergović, pon.

Rojeni Sarajevčan več kot 30 let živi v Zagrebu. Spisal je več kot 30 del, polovica jih je na voljo tudi v slovenščini, jeziku, ki ga hrvaško-bosanski pisatelj razume. programme.title: Josip Ipavec, Slovenian Mozart, Music Documentary, Mon. / Josip Ipavec, slovenski Mozart, glasbeni dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: R: Boštjančič Vojko ... Composer Josip Ipavec (1873–1921) comes from the famous family of composers and doctors from Šentjur near Celje. He is less known to the public than his father (Gustav) or Uncle (Benjamin). Josip Ipavec is considered to be an important composer of self -singing and choirs, and in his oeuvre the first Slovenian ballet Mozicek and the opera Princess of Vrtoglavka stand out. In his choir songs, he clearly professed his love for his homeland and Slovene at a time when he was spoken and written in Slovene. His works left an indelible mark, and during his life he was less well known and appreciated at home than abroad. In the film Ipavc's life and musical path, Igor Grdina, Konrad Rado Frece, Matej Romih, Pavel Mihelčič, Franci Plohl, Tomaž Faganel, Darja Koter, Vojko Vidmar and Lojze Arlič, and the film is enriched Hribernika, United Men's Choirs of the Šentjur Municipality and students of the Šentjur Nuša Music School and Tjaša Štrajhar. Linker Saša Tabakovic - Josip Ipavec, script Jernej Kastelec, expert associate ddr. Igor Grdina, director of photography Uroš Hočevar, set designer Greta Godnič, costume designer Jerneja Jambrek, editor Andrej Modic. The editor of the show Daniel Celarec, director Vojko Boštjančič. / R: Boštjančič Vojko... Skladatelj Josip Ipavec (1873–1921) izhaja iz znamenite družine skladateljev in zdravnikov iz Šentjurja pri Celju. Javnosti je manj poznan kot njegov oče (Gustav) ali stric (Benjamin). Josip Ipavec velja za pomembnega skladatelja samospevov in zborov, v njegovem opusu pa izstopata prvi slovenski balet Možiček in opera Princesa Vrtoglavka. V svojih zborovskih skladbah je jasno izpovedal svojo ljubezen do domovine in slovenskega jezika v času, ko se je na Slovenskem govorilo in pisalo nemško. Njegova dela so pustila neizbrisen pečat, v času življenja pa je bil doma manj poznan in cenjen kot v tujini. V filmu Ipavčevo življenjsko in glasbeno pot predstavijo Igor Grdina, Konrad Rado Frece, Matej Romih, Pavel Mihelčič, Franci Plohl, Tomaž Faganel, Darja Koter, Vojko Vidmar in Lojze Arlič, film pa bogatijo igrani prizori ter televizijske upodobitve Ipavčeve glasbe v izvedbi Marcosa Finka, Urške Arlič Gololičič in Marka Hribernika, Združenih moških pevskih zborov Občine Šentjur ter učencev Glasbene šole Šentjur Nuše in Tjaše Štrajhar. Povezovalec Saša Tabaković – Josip Ipavec, scenarij Jernej Kastelec, strokovni sodelavec ddr. Igor Grdina, direktor fotografije Uroš Hočevar, scenografinja Greta Godnič, kostumografinja Jerneja Jambrek, montažer Andrej Modic. Urednik oddaje Daniel Celarec, režiser Vojko Boštjančič.

programme.title: Hemp frees, documentary, Mon. / Konoplja osvobaja, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Celar Miha ... Cannabis is liberating a documentary film essay that talks about activists from Slovenia, the former Yugoslavia and elsewhere who devoted their lives to the use of cannabis. / R: Čelar Miha... KONOPLJA OSVOBAJA je dokumentarni filmski esej, ki govori o aktivistih iz Sloveniji, bivše Jugoslavije in drugod, ki so svoja življenja posvetili rabi konoplje.
programme.desc: Some came in conflict with the law, and everyone in one way or another embarked on the path of the cannabis revolution. The main protagonist of the film is Janko Pirc, who achieved an acquittal in the Supreme Court in 2016 after being convicted of raising and using eight cannabis seedlings, with whom he wanted to help his son and ex -wife. The film, with the narrative of the musician and philosopher Ramb Amadeus, with humorous distance, describes how in the rapidly developing hemp industry, despite the opposition of medicine, which still has a drug, politics, pharmacy and capital are entering. The authors want to shed light on all the sides of the future relationship between cannabis and society, thus encouraging people to think and education that would give everyone a good and thoughtful attitude towards future medical and recreational use of cannabis. / Nekateri so pri tem prišli v navzkriž z zakonom, vsi pa so tako ali drugače stopili na pot konopljine revolucije. Glavni protagonist filma je Janko Pirc, ki je leta 2016 dosegel oprostilno sodbo na vrhovnem sodišču, potem, ko je bil obsojen zaradi vzgoje in rabe osmih sadik konoplje, s katerimi je želel pomagati sinu in bivši ženi. Film ob pripovedi glasbenika in filozofa Ramba Amadeusa, s humorno distanco opisuje, kako v bliskovito razvijajočo se industrijo konoplje, kljub nasprotovanju medicine, ki ima konopljo še vedno za mamilo, vstopajo politika, farmacija in kapital. Avtorji želimo s filmom osvetliti vse plati prihodnjega odnosa med konopljo in družbo ter tako ljudi spodbuditi k razmišljanju in izobraževanju, ki bi vsakomur omogočilo dober in premišljen odnos do prihodnje medicinske in rekreativne uporabe konoplje.Scenarij in režija Miha Čelar.

programme.desc: Cate McCall is a California lawyer. Conscientious and enthusiastic, as well as vulnerable, which pushes it into the embrace of alcohol. Her career is at risk as she quarreled with the judge in court. At the same time, Cate is fighting for custody of a daughter who lives with her father. When she is assigned to Lacey Stubbs, a young man convicted of murder as a court defense, a bunch of heavy battles are waiting for her. Cate has not lost the case so far, and with the help of a friend Bridges this time, she also collects evidence that speak in favor of her client. But - is this really innocent? Original title: The Trials of Kate McCall Year of Production: 2013 Spring: USA: Court Dramarizer: Karen Moncrrieffscenario: Karen Moncrrieffigraji: Kate Beckinsale, Nick Nolte, James Cromwell, Anna Schafer. / Cate McCall je kalifornijska odvetnica. Vestna in zagnana, pa tudi ranljiva, kar jo potisne v objem alkohola. Njena kariera je v nevarnosti, saj se je na sodišču sprla s sodnikom. programme.title: Let's bite science: learning with movement, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Učenje z gibanjem, pon.
programme.desc: R: Vilar Mile ... Research has shown that more powerful children at school have better success. The golden graduates are similar to top athletes in terms of movement skills. The movement therefore helps us to learn. Today, the amount of knowledge is increasing, so we are looking for new ways to learn effectively. One of them is learning with movement. Physical activity has a profound effect on brain function. As we move, our brains receive more blood and nutrients, which strengthens the connections between different brain centers. We will show you how students, students and students as well as dramatic players learn successfully. / R: Vilar Mile... Raziskave so pokazale, da imajo telesno zmogljivejši otroci v šoli boljši uspeh. Zlati maturanti so po gibalnih sposobnostih podobni vrhunskim športnikom. Gibanje nam torej pomaga pri učenju. Danes je količina znanja čedalje večja, zato iščemo nove načine za učinkovito učenje. Eden izmed njih je učenje z gibanjem. Telesna dejavnost močno vpliva na delovanje možganov. Ko se gibamo, prejemajo naši možgani več krvi in hranil, kar krepi povezave med različnimi možganskimi centri. Pokazali vam bomo, kako se uspešno učijo učenci, dijaki in študentje in tudi dramski igralci.

programme.title: Listen!, Documentary Felts, Mon. / Poslušaj!, dokumentarni feljton, pon.
programme.desc: R: Primoz Meško ... Listen to the documentary foelon! It shows the shocking story of musician Milan Ostojic, who, thirty years ago, together with his family, came from Croatia to Slovenia. In a hurry to escape before the war, they were left without documents. The film narrative reveals their twenty -year efforts to obtain permanent residence and find a new home. In the fight for survival, they were helped by music. The Halgato band, founded by Milan Ostojic, still performs at concerts today. Listen! Not only is an invitation to listen to their emotionally expressive music. Listen! It is a rotating request for some refugees to listen to them with understanding. Screenplay Cvetka Bevc, directed by Primož Meško, director of photography and cameraman Andrej Lupinc. Production of the editorial board of documentary broadcasts TV Slovenia, cultural and art program, editor -in -chief Andraž Poschl. / R: Primož Meško... Dokumentarni feljton POSLUŠAJ! prikazuje pretresljivo zgodbo o glasbeniku Milana Ostojiću, ki je pred tridesetimi leti skupaj z družino prišel iz Hrvaške v Slovenijo. V naglici bega pred vojno vihro so ostali brez dokumentov. Filmska pripoved razkriva njihovo dvajset let trajajoče prizadevanje za pridobitev stalnega prebivališča in iskanje novega doma. V boju za preživetje jim je pomagala glasba. Halgato band, ki ga je ustanovil Milan Ostojić, še danes nastopa na koncertih. Poslušaj! ni le vabilo k poslušanju njihove emocionalno ekspresivne glasbe. Poslušaj! je roteča prošnja prenekaterih beguncev, da jim z razumevanjem prisluhnemo. Scenarij Cvetka Bevc, režija Primož Meško, direktor fotografije in snemalec Andrej Lupinc. Produkcija Uredništvo dokumentarnih oddaj TV Slovenija, Kulturni in umetniški program, odgovorni urednik Andraž Poschl.

programme.title: Automotive: In practice, we tried an autonomous ride, Mon. / Avtomobilnost: V praksi smo preizkusili avtonomno vožnjo, pon.
programme.sub-title: The show will be fully dedicated to autonomous driving. We report two autonomous car rides. Of course we didn't drive them, but we drove around Europe. / Oddaja bo v celoti posvečena avtonomni vožnji. Poročamo o dveh vožnjah z avtonomnima avtomobiloma. Seveda ju nismo vozili, peljali pa smo se in to po Evropi.
programme.desc: In the UK, we sat in Nissan Leaf, which has more than 25,000 autonomous miles on the highway, including through London. She impressed driving on local roads at a hundred miles per hour. The car automatically drove us dynamically, on public roads, behaving and deciding as a competent driver. At the French racetrack, the "self -driving" Toyota Yaris Gru drove us even more dynamically, even racing. In both cases, engineers told us that the aim of the project is to imitate human behavior. At the wheel, we also learned powerful assistive systems, in the infamous Tesla Model Y and in the European car of the year Renault Scenic. / V Veliki Britaniji smo sedli v Nissana Leafa, ki ima za sabo že več kot 25.000 avtonomnih kilometrov po avtocesti, tudi skozi London. Navdušila je vožnja po lokalnih cestah pri sto kilometrih na uro. Avto nas je samodejno vozil dinamično, po javnih cestah in se pri tem obnašal ter odločal kot kompetenten voznik.Na francoskem dirkališču nas je »samovozeča« Toyota Yaris GR zapeljala še bolj dinamično, celo dirkaško. V obeh primerih so nam inženirji povedali, da je cilj projektov posnemati človeško vedenje. Za volanom smo spoznali tudi zmogljive asistenčne sisteme in sicer v zloglasni Tesli modela Y ter v evropskem avtu leta Renaultu Scenicu.

programme.title: Outside of Frame: Borut Furlan, Passionate Researcher of the Underwater Councils, Entertainment Talk, Mon. / Izven okvirja: Borut Furlan, strastni raziskovalec podvodnih svetov, razvedrilno pogovorna oddaja, pon.

programme.title: Cankar, documentary feature film, Mon. / Cankar, dokumentarno igrani film, pon.
programme.sub-title: Dokumentarno-igrani film Cankar nam v igranih prizorih približa zasebno življenje največjega slovenskega pisatelja.
programme.desc: The film narrative begins in November 1899, when Ivan Cankar hires a cabinet on the Loffler family in the Vienna suburb of Ottakring. At first she approaches the gentlemen, and later her growing daughters Steffi. They have settled down for almost ten years and creates most of his works there. On his visit to his brother Karl in Sarajevo, he is the guest of Archbishop Josip Stadler. He writes the servants there and decides not to return to the fiancé in Vienna. The following years he lives on Ljubljana Rožnik. He also gets involved with the girls there; He is an attentive lover, sociable and extremely intelligent. It fools the misery of an impoverished working class around him and is impressed for social democracy. The rebellion against the criminal social order is translated by the entire Cankar's oeuvre. The reconstructions of some public appearances in the film emphasizes the power and actuality of his political word. In terms of reading Cankar's works, he reveals details from the writer's life. In his almost film descriptions, we recognize the spaces, portraits of loved ones and contemporaries. Many of what he described in the literature had experienced a few years later. In the thoughtful interweaving of playful, animated and documentary, manuscripts and letters from his legacy are woven into play scenes. The heroes in the film speak with words from Cankar's prose. The Film raises the question of how the myth of Ivan Cankar has formed in a good century. The magnificent oeuvre of novels, stories, lines, poems, essays, political speeches, articles and letters offers a wide field of interpretations. Cankar was appropriated both on the left and right. In the documentary, we face connoisseurs who passionately reveal the overlooked side of the writer's work. We are convinced that we have learned everything about Cankar in a good century, but we really only know his work superficially. / Filmska pripoved se začne novembra 1899, ko Ivan Cankar najame kabinet pri družini Loffler v dunajskem predmestju Ottakring. Sprva se približa gospodinji, pozneje pa njeni odraščajoči hčeri Steffi. Pri njih se ustali za skoraj deset let in tam ustvari večino svojih del.Ob obisku brata Karla v Sarajevu je gost nadškofa Josipa Stadlerja. Tam napiše Hlapce in se odloči, da se ne bo vrnil k zaročenki na Dunaj. Naslednja leta živi na ljubljanskem Rožniku. Tudi tam se zapleta s tamkajšnjimi dekleti; je pozoren ljubimec, družaben in izjemno inteligenten.Opazuje bedo obubožanega delavskega razreda okoli sebe in se navduši za socialdemokracijo. Upor proti krivičnemu družbenemu redu preveva celoten Cankarjev opus. Z rekonstrukcijami nekaterih javnih nastopov v filmu je poudarjena moč in aktualnost njegove politične besede.Pozorno branje Cankarjevih del nam razkriva podrobnosti iz pisateljevega življenja. V njegovih skoraj filmskih opisih prepoznavamo prostore, portrete najbližjih in sodobnikov. Marsikaj, kar je opisal v literaturi, je nekaj let pozneje tudi sam doživel. V premišljenih prepletih igranega, animiranega in dokumentarnega so rokopisi in pisma iz njegove zapuščine vtkani v igrane prizore. Junaki v filmu spregovorijo z besedami iz Cankarjeve proze.Film odpira vprašanje, kako se je v dobrem stoletju izoblikoval mit o Ivanu Cankarju. Veličasten opus romanov, povesti, črtic, pesmi, esejev, političnih govorov, člankov in pisem ponuja široko polje interpretacij. Cankarja so si prisvajali tako na levici kot na desnici. V dokumentarnem delu filma se srečujemo s poznavalci, ki strastno razkrivajo prezrte plati pisateljevega dela. Prepričani smo, da smo o Cankarju v dobrem stoletju izvedeli vse, vendar njegovo delo v resnici le površno poznamo.

To je med njimi stkalo močne ustvarjalne vezi, na podlagi katerih se je oblikovala skupina Barcelona Gipsy Klezmer Orchestra (BGKO). Z odličnimi interpretacijami in energijo, ki jo širijo med občinstvo, navdušujejo na najrazličnejših glasbenih prizoriščih po Evropi. Prinesli so jo tudi na Mestni trg Ljubljane leta 2013 ob odprtju 25. Noči v Stari Ljubljani, ki jih pripravlja ustanova Imago Sloveniae – Podoba Slovenije. programme.title: Reverse, documentary film, pon. / Reverz, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Frelih Anton ... After World War II, Slovenia adopted a decree establishing a federal collection center. / R: Frelih Anton... Po drugi svetovni vojni je Slovenija sprejela odlok o ustanovitvi Federalnega zbirnega centra.
programme.desc: Special commissions have "selected" valuable objects (art paintings and statues, ancient furniture, carpets, porcelain, instruments and more) throughout the country. In Ljubljana, a collection center with three warehouses operated in Ljubljana, and three more area branches in Celje, Maribor and Novo mesto. It was a form of nationalization, which at that time was accompanied by an apology that he was taking war criminals and thus ensuring the preservation of these objects in Slovenia. But many objects were taken by the people of Slovenia with a purely "clear" war of the past, only they had too much for the concepts of the time. Thus, the excuse to preserve the cultural heritage in Slovenia by nationalization was quite empty. Private property was roughly trampled. He finished some of the confiscated subjects in the then government and ministerial premises, art galleries, museums and schools, and ended up a considerable part of the subjects in the hands of important, for the time of deserving individuals who were at the top of the political structure. The screenwriter and director of the documentary is Tone Frelih. / Posebne komisije so po deželi »odbirale« vredne predmete (umetniške slike in kipe, antično pohištvo, preproge, porcelan, glasbila in drugo). V Ljubljani je delovala centrala zbirnega centra s tremi skladišči, po Sloveniji pa še tri področne izpostave, v Celju, Mariboru in Novem mestu. Šlo je za obliko nacionalizacije, ki jo je takratna oblast pospremila z opravičilom, da jemlje vojni zločincem in da na ta način zagotavlja ohranitev teh predmetov v Sloveniji. Toda veliko predmetov je bilo vzetih prebivalcem Slovenije s povsem »čisto« vojno preteklostjo, le imeli so preveč za takratne pojme. Tako je bil izgovor, da z nacionalizacijo ohranjajo kulturno dediščino v Sloveniji, precej prazen. Zasebna lastnina je bila grobo poteptana. Del tako zaplenjenih predmetov je dokumentirano končal v takratnih vladnih in ministrskih prostorih , umetniških galerijah, muzejih in šolah, precejšen del predmetov pa je končal v rokah pomembnih, za takratni čas zaslužnih posameznikov, ki so bili v vrhu politične strukture.Danes lahko pretežni del dokumentacije o ustanovitvi in delovanju Federalnega zbirnega centra ter o zaplenjenih predmetih najdemo v Arhivu Republike Slovenije. Scenarist in režiser dokumentarnega filma je Tone Frelih.

programme.title: Surfing.es
programme.desc: Surf is a very spectacular modality, both for those who see it and for the one who practices it. programme.title: Mundial de saltos de natacion

programme.title: Europeo masculino de hockey hierba
programme.desc: The German city of Monchengladbach hosts the European hockey male grass from August 8 to 16. Dort bespricht das Trio erste Details. Bunte Fische vor einem dusteren Hintergrund: Die Einrichtung des 1000-Liter-Beckens gestalten die Profi-Handwerker mit Totenkopfen, Knochen, einer Version von Ashbas Logo und einer Gitarre. Bewohnt wird das Gruselkabinett von Muranen und Zigarren-Lippfischen.Gross, grosser, am grossten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10 Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Öko-System mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arzt-Praxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen.Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasser-Bewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum.Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihrer beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus
